nodes.statement_en: Assume $f,g$ are both continuous maps from $\mathbb{R}$ to some Hausdorff topological space $Y$. If $$f(r)=g(r),\forall r \in \mathbb{Q}$$ then $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.$$
key_techniques: density of the rational numbers in $\mathbb{R}$
continuity and uniqueness from a dense subset
nodes.callout_body: 假设$f,g$都是由$\mathbb{R}$到某个Hausdroff的拓扑空间$Y$的连续映射，如果$$f(r)=g(r),\forall r \in \mathbb{Q}$$那么$$f(x)=g(x),\forall x \in \mathbb{R}$$

nodes.source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用
nodes.english_source_note: Borel-Cantelli Lemma and Applications
nodes.callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用#1
nodes.statement_en: Let $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$ be a measure space, and let $E_1,E_2,E_3,\dots \in \mathcal{F}$ satisfy $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mu(E_n)<\infty.$$ Then $$\mu\left(\bigcup_{n\geq N}E_n\right)\to0,$$ equivalently, almost every $x\in X$ belongs to at most finitely many of the sets $E_n$, that is, $$\mu(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)=0.$$
nodes.callout_body:
$(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$是一个测度空间，$E_1,E_2,E_3,...\in \mathcal{F}$并且满足测度的和收敛，$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mu(E_n)<\infty$$
那么$$\mu\left(\bigcup_{n\geq N}E_n\right)\to0$$或者说几乎所有$x\in X$都包含在至多有限个$E_n$当中，即$$\mu(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)=0$$

nodes.source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用
nodes.english_source_note: Borel-Cantelli Lemma and Applications
nodes.callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用#2
nodes.statement_en: In the measure space $([0,1],\mathcal{B}([0,1]),m)$, where $m$ is Lebesgue measure, let $I_n = [0,\frac{1}{n^2}]$. Since $$\sum_{n\geq 1} m(I_n)=\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{1}{n^2}<\infty,$$ it follows that $m(x\in I_n \text{ i.o. })=0$. In other words, almost every point of $[0,1]$ belongs to only finitely many intervals of the form $I_n = [0,\frac{1}{n^2}]$. In fact, the only point belonging to infinitely many such intervals is $x=0$.
key_techniques: computation of Lebesgue measures of intervals
nodes.callout_body: $([0,1],\mathcal{B}([0,1]),m)$是一个测度空间，$m$是Lebesgue测度。假设集合$I_n = [0,\frac{1}{n^2}]$,那么因为$$\sum_{n\geq 1} m(I_n)=\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{1}{n^2}<\infty$$因此$m(x\in I_n \text{ i.o. })=0$。也就是说，$[0,1]$上几乎所有点都只属于有限多个形如$I_n = [0,\frac{1}{n^2}]$的区间，这很显然。其实这里唯一一个属于无穷多个此类区间的点就只有$x=0$这一个点罢了。

nodes.source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用
nodes.english_source_note: Borel-Cantelli Lemma and Applications
nodes.callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用#3
nodes.statement_en: In the Lebesgue measure space $([0,1],\mathcal{L}([0,1]),m)$, consider the sequence of sets $E_n:=(0,\frac{1}{n})$. Define $A_N:=\cup_{n\geq N}E_n$. Then $A_N=(0,\frac{1}{N})$, so by continuity of measure from above, $$m(\limsup_{n\to \infty}E_n)=\lim_{N\to \infty}m(A_N)=0.$$ However, $m(E_n)=\frac{1}{n}$ and the series formed by these measures diverges.
key_techniques: explicit computation of a limsup set
nodes.callout_body: $([0,1],\mathcal{L}([0,1]),m)$是集合$[0,1]$上的Lebesgue测度空间，其中$m$是Lebesgue测度。考虑此空间上的一列集合列$E_n:=(0,\frac{1}{n})$。定义$A_N:=\cup_{n\geq N}E_n$，我们知道$A_N=(0,\frac{1}{N})$，依据测度的“自上而下的连续性”，我们知道$$m(\limsup_{n\to \infty}E_n)=\lim_{N\to \infty}m(A_N)=0$$然而如果我们会发现$m(E_n)=\frac{1}{n}$其组成的级数是不收敛的。

nodes.source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用
nodes.english_source_note: Borel-Cantelli Lemma and Applications
nodes.callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用#4
nodes.statement_en: For each $\varepsilon > 0$, define $$A_{n,\varepsilon}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq\varepsilon\}.$$ If for every $\varepsilon > 0$ one has $$\sum_{n\geq1}\mu(A_{n,\varepsilon})<\infty,$$ then $$\mu\left(\limsup_{n\to\infty}A_{n,\varepsilon}\right)=0,\quad \forall \varepsilon>0,$$ and hence $$f_n(x) \to f(x) \text{ a.e. }x.$$
nodes.callout_body:
如果$\forall \varepsilon > 0$,定义集合$A_{n,\varepsilon}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq\varepsilon\}$都有
$$\sum_{n\geq1}\mu(A_{n,\varepsilon})<\infty$$那么可以得到结论
$$\mu\left(\limsup_{n\to\infty}A_{n,\varepsilon}\right)=0,\forall \varepsilon>0$$于是
$$f_n(x) \to f(x) \text{ a.e. }x$$

nodes.source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用
nodes.english_source_note: Borel-Cantelli Lemma and Applications
nodes.callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用#5
nodes.statement_en: Let $$A_{n}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq \varepsilon_n\},$$ where $\varepsilon_n \downarrow 0$, and suppose also that $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mu(A_n)<\infty.$$ Then if $x \not \in \limsup_{n\to\infty} A_{n}$, there exists $N_x$ such that for all $n >N_x$, $$|f_n(x)-f(x)|< \varepsilon_n.$$ Hence $f_n(x)\to f(x)$, and therefore $$f_n(x)\to f(x)$$ almost everywhere.
nodes.callout_body:
$$A_{n}:=\{x:|f_n(x)-f(x)|\geq \varepsilon_n\}$$其中$\varepsilon_n \downarrow 0$，并且同时$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mu(A_n)<\infty$$
于是按照上面同样的做法，如果$x \not \in \limsup_{n\to\infty} A_{n}$那么存在一个$N_x$使得$\forall n >N_x$都有$$|f_n(x)-f(x)|< \varepsilon_n$$同样能表示$f_n(x)\to f(x)$，那么能得到结论，$$f_n(x)\to f(x)$$几乎处处成立。

nodes.source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用

nodes.callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用#6
nodes.statement_en: Let $E_1,E_2,\dots \in\mathcal{F}$ be mutually independent, and suppose that $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mathbb{P}(E_n)=\infty.$$ Then $$\mathbb{P}(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)=\mathbb{P}(E_n \text{ i.o.})=1.$$
nodes.callout_body:
集合列$E_1,..,E_n,..\in\mathcal{F}$互相之间是独立的，并且其测度形成的集合不收敛$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mathbb{P}(E_n)=\infty$$
那么$$\mathbb{P}(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)=\mathbb{P}(E_n \text{ i.o.})=1$$

nodes.statement_en: Let $E_1,E_2,\dots \in\mathcal{F}$ be mutually independent, and suppose that $\mathbb{P}(E_n)<1$. Then $$\mathbb{P}(\cup_{n\geq 1}E_n)=1\implies \mathbb{P}(E_n \text{ i.o.})=1.$$
key_techniques: reformulation of the second Borel-Cantelli lemma
nodes.callout_body: 合列$E_1,..,E_n,..\in\mathcal{F}$互相之间是独立的，并且$\mathbb{P}(E_n)<1$那么$$\mathbb{P}(\cup_{n\geq 1}E_n)=1\implies \mathbb{P}(E_n \text{ i.o.})=1$$

nodes.source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用
nodes.english_source_note: Borel-Cantelli Lemma and Applications
nodes.callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma及其应用#8
nodes.english_title: Quantitative Version of the Second Borel-Cantelli Lemma
nodes.statement_en: Let $E_1,E_2,\dots \in\mathcal{F}$ satisfy the condition that there exists a positive real number $C$ such that $$\sum_{i,j\leq N}\mathbb{P}(E_i \cap E_j)\leq C \left(\sum_{i\leq N}\mathbb{P}(E_i)\right)^2$$ for infinitely many positive integers $N$, and suppose also that $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mathbb{P}(E_n)=\infty.$$ Then $$\mathbb{P}(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)\geq \frac{1}{C}.$$
nodes.callout_body:
集合列$E_1,..,E_n,..\in\mathcal{F}$满足存在一个正实数$C$使得$$\sum_{i,j\leq N}\mathbb{P}(E_i \cap E_j)\leq C \left(\sum_{i\leq N}\mathbb{P}(E_i)\right)^2$$对无穷多个正整数$N$成立，并且其测度形成的集合不收敛$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mathbb{P}(E_n)=\infty$$
那么$$\mathbb{P}(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)\geq \frac{1}{C}$$

strategies.strategy_name_en: Convert set problems into function problems via indicator functions
strategies.summary_en: Represent events or sets by their indicator functions, and then analyze the resulting functions using tools from function spaces and integration. This turns questions about set occurrence into questions about convergence or bounds for functions.
strategies.applicability: Use this strategy when a measure-theoretic or probabilistic question about sets can be reformulated in terms of indicator functions, especially for applying analytic tools to limsup events, averages, or convergence.
strategies.callout_body: 通过集合的特征函数把集合的问题转换为函数的问题，使用处理函数的工具来分析问题。

nodes.statement_en: Let $q$ be a positive integer. nodes.callout_id: 由一个级数收敛证明另一个有关级数的收敛问题#5
nodes.statement_en: Assume $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n$ converges absolutely, and let $p>1/2$. Prove that $$\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{\sqrt{|a_n|}}{n^p}<+\infty.$$
key_techniques: split the index set into two cases
nodes.callout_body:
[[Riemann-Lebesgue引理的一个特殊情况#^abe598]]当中有这样一个问题：

假设$\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n$绝对收敛，并且$p>1/2$，证明$$\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{\sqrt{|a_n|}}{n^p}<+\infty$$
除了利用柯西不等式以外，我们还可以尝试用本文当中的思路解决问题。

令$M:=\{n:\frac{\sqrt{|a_n|}}{n^p}\leq |a_n|\}$于是当$n\in M^c$的时候$|a_n|\leq \frac{1}{n^{2p}}$，从而$\frac{\sqrt{|a_n|}}{n^p}\leq \frac{1}{n^{2p}}$。于是$$\begin{aligned}\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{\sqrt{|a_n|}}{n^p}&= \sum_{n\in M}*+\sum_{n\in M^c}*\\&\leq \sum_{n\in M} |a_n|+\sum_{n\in M^c} \frac{1}{n^{2p}}\\&\leq \sum_{n\geq 1}|a_n|+\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{1}{n^{2p}}<+\infty\end{aligned}$$

nodes.statement_en: For the critical case $p=1$, let $a_n>0$ and suppose $\sum_n \frac{1}{a_n}$ converges. Prove that $\sum_n \frac{n}{A_n}$ converges, where $A_n$ is the sum of the first $n$ terms of the sequence $a_k$.
key_techniques: testing the limits of a partition strategy
nodes.callout_body:
参考[[Carleman不等式#^d22522]]当中的例子，对于关键的$p=1$的情况。对于正实数序列$a_k$,已知$\sum_n \frac{1}{a_n}$收敛，现在我们要证明$\sum_k \frac{n}{A_n}$收敛，其中$A_n$是序列$a_k$的前$n$项和。

这个时候如果我们要考虑，哪些$n$能够使得不等式$\frac{n}{A_n}\leq \frac{1}{a_n}$我们其实导不出什么有用的信息。

nodes.callout_id: 和与积分换序#5
nodes.english_title: Proposition 3.1.3: nth Moments of Exponentially Decaying Functions on the Positive Half-Line
nodes.statement_en: Compute the moments \(b_n:=\int_0^{\infty} g(x)x^n\,dx\) for several common functions on \([0,\infty)\), including \(g(x)=e^{-ax}\), \(g(x)=e^{-ax^2}\), \(g(x)=\frac{1}{e^x-1}\), and \(g(x)=\frac{1}{e^x+1}\), obtaining explicit formulas in terms of \(\Gamma\) and \(\zeta\) functions.
prerequisites: justification of exchanging sum and integral
nodes.callout_body:
区间$[0,+\infty)$上常见的$n$次矩简单的函数$g(x)$以及它们的$n$次矩$b_n:=\int_0^{\infty}g(x)x^n\,dx$：
* 指数衰减型$e^{-ax}$，$$\begin{aligned}b_n&=\int_0^{\infty}e^{-ax}x^n\,dx \xlongequal{t=ax}\frac{1}{a^{n+1}}\int_0^{\infty}t^ne^{-t}\,dt \\&= \frac{\Gamma(n+1)}{a^{n+1}}\\&=\frac{n!}{a^{n+1}}\end{aligned}$$
* 高斯函数$e^{-ax^2}$,$$\begin{aligned}b_n&=\int_0^{\infty}e^{-ax^2}x^n\\&\xlongequal{t=ax^2}\frac{1}{2a^{(n+1)/2}}\int_0^{\infty}t^{\frac{n}{2}-\frac{1}{2}}e^{-t}\,dt \\&=\frac{\Gamma(\frac{n+1}{2})}{2a^{(n+1)/2}}\end{aligned}$$
* 玻色-爱因斯坦分布（简化）$\frac{1}{e^x-1}$。这个函数的$n$次矩的计算本身就体现了"想法3.1.2"的技巧，我们利用$$\frac{1}{e^x-1}=\frac{e^{-x}}{1-e^{-x}}=\sum_{k\geq 1} e^{-kx}$$从而交换次序，并结合上面已经推导出来的指数型的普通n次矩的结论，得到$$\begin{aligned}b_n&=\int_0^{\infty}\frac{x^n}{e^x-1}\,dx \\&= \int_0^{\infty}x^n\sum_{k\geq 1} e^{-kx}\\&= \sum_{k\geq 1}\int_0^{\infty}x^ne^{-kx} \,dx \\&= \sum_{k\geq 1}\frac{n!}{k^{n+1}}\\&=n!\zeta(n+1)\end{aligned}$$
* 费米-狄拉克分布（简化），方法与思路与上一个类似。利用$$\frac{1}{e^x+1}=\frac{e^{-x}}{1+e^{-x}}=\sum_{k\geq 1} (-1)^{k-1}e^{-kx}$$从而$$\begin{aligned}b_n&=\int_0^{\infty}\frac{x^n}{e^x+1}\,dx \\&= \int_0^{\infty}x^n\sum_{k\geq 1} (-1)^{k-1}e^{-kx}\\&= \sum_{k\geq 1}(-1)^{k-1}\int_0^{\infty}x^ne^{-kx} \,dx \\&= n!\sum_{k\geq 1}\frac{(-1)^{k-1}}{k^{n+1}}\\&=n!(1-2^{-n})\zeta(n+1)\end{aligned}$$

nodes.callout_id: 和与积分换序#8
nodes.english_title: Proposition 3.1.6: Common nth Moments on the Interval (0,1)
nodes.statement_en: Compute the moments \(b_n:=\int_0^1 g(x)x^n\,dx\) for common functions on \((0,1)\), including \((\ln x)^k\), \((1-x)^a\), and \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}\), expressing the results using Gamma and Beta functions and related factorial formulas.
nodes.callout_body:
相比于无穷区间，有限区间$(0,1)$上的积分矩通常与 $\Gamma$ 函数、Beta 函数以及阶乘幂密切相关。以下是常见的 $g(x)$ 及其 $n$ 次矩 $b_n:=\int_0^1 g(x)x^n\,dx$：
* **对数函数** $(\ln x)^k$(其中$k$为正整数)。利用换元 $x=e^{-t}$ 将其转化为 Gamma 函数积分：
$$\begin{aligned}b_n&=\int_0^1 x^n (\ln x)^k \,dx \\&\xlongequal{x=e^{-t}} \int_{\infty}^0 e^{-nt}(-t)^k (-e^{-t})\,dt \\&= (-1)^k \int_0^{\infty} t^k e^{-(n+1)t}\,dt \\&= (-1)^k \frac{\Gamma(k+1)}{(n+1)^{k+1}} = (-1)^k \frac{k!}{(n+1)^{k+1}}\end{aligned}$$
* 特别地，当 $k=1$ 时，$b_n = -\frac{1}{(n+1)^2}$。
* **移位幂函数** $(1-x)^a$(其中$a>-1$)。这直接对应于 Euler Beta 函数的定义：
$$\begin{aligned}b_n&=\int_0^1 x^n (1-x)^a \,dx \\&= B(n+1, a+1) \\&= \frac{\Gamma(n+1)\Gamma(a+1)}{\Gamma(n+a+2)}\end{aligned}$$如果 $a$ 是正整数 $m$，则 $b_n = \frac{n!m!}{(n+m+1)!}$。
* $\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}$。利用三角换元 $x=\sin \theta$ 转化为 Wallis 积分公式：
$$\begin{aligned}b_n&=\int_0^1 \frac{x^n}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}\,dx \\&\xlongequal{x=\sin \theta} \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin^n \theta \,d\theta \\&= \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}\frac{\Gamma(\frac{n+1}{2})}{\Gamma(\frac{n}{2}+1)}\end{aligned}$$此时通常需要讨论 $n$ 的奇偶性。若 $n=2k$，则 $b_{2k} = \frac{\pi}{2}\frac{(2k-1)!!}{(2k)!!} = \frac{\pi}{2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{4^k}$。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Rewrite and interchange summation and integration
strategies.summary_en: When a sum or integral is hard to evaluate directly, rewrite the integrand or summand itself as a new sum or integral. Then interchange the two operations and check whether the new expression is easier to compute or estimate.
strategies.applicability: Applies when the target quantity can be expanded into a series or represented by another integral, and the exchanged order leads to simpler inner sums or integrals.
strategies.callout_body:
1. 如果我们有一个求和/积分问题，比如$\sum X$这个和或$\int X$这个积分是难以处理的，
2. 此时我们又发现我们可以把$X$写成一个新的和或者积分，$X=\sum Y$或者$X =\int Y$那么此时我们得到了:
$$\sum \sum Y \text{ or }\sum \int Y\text{ or } \int \sum Y \text{ or }\int \int Y$$
3. 交换二者的次序，试试看交换以后的结果会不会更好。简单来说就是给目标对象换一个表达方式，并且期望这个新的表达比原本的表达在当前状况下更好处理。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Expand one factor and reduce to moments
strategies.summary_en: For an integral of the form \(\int f(x)g(x)\,dx\), expand \(g(x)=\sum a_n x^n\) and interchange summation and integration to obtain \(\sum a_n \int f(x)x^n\,dx\). The method is useful when the moments of \(f\) are explicit or easy to estimate and the resulting series is manageable.
strategies.applicability: Applies when one factor admits a power series expansion and the moment integrals \(\int f(x)x^n\,dx\) are known, computable, or well estimated.
strategies.callout_body:
此时我们展开无非就是得到：$$\int f(x)g(x) = \int f(x)\sum a_n x^n = \sum a_n\int f(x)x^n$$无论是计算积分还是做积分估计，我们需要保证两点：
1. $f$的n次矩，也就是$b_n:=\int f(x)x^n$对我们而言是简单的（已知，好算，好估计）
2. $\sum a_n b_n$对我们来说是简单的（已知，好算，好估计）

strategies.strategy_name_en: Expand after a change of variable or auxiliary substitution
strategies.summary_en: Instead of expanding \(g(x)\) directly, rewrite it as \(h(u(x))\), expand \(h\) into a series, and then interchange summation and integration. This shifts attention from ordinary moments to generalized moments such as \(\int f(x)u(x)^n\,dx\).
strategies.applicability: Applies when the original integrand is not naturally expandable in \(x\), but becomes suitable for series expansion after introducing a transformed variable or auxiliary function.
strategies.callout_body: 有时候，展开未必是直接对$g$进行展开，而是$$\int f(x)g(x)=\int f(x)h(u)$$其中$h(u)=g(x)$。然后我们是对$h(u)$进行展开，从而得到$$\int f(x)h(u)=\int f(x)\sum a_n u^n = \sum a_n \int f(x)u^n(x)$$也就是说，我们也不能只是关注那些普通的$n$次矩好算的函数$f$，也要关注对于一些特殊的n次矩$\int f(x)u^n(x)$优化的函数。

nodes.callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#6
nodes.english_title: Theorem 2.1.1: Cauchy Criterion for Riemann Integrability
nodes.statement_en: A function $f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$ is Riemann integrable if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$, there exists $\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$ such that for any tagged partitions $(P',\xi')$ and $(P'',\xi'')$ satisfying $\lambda(P'),\lambda(P'')<\delta_{\varepsilon}$, one has $$|S_f(P',\xi')-S_f(P'',\xi'')|<\varepsilon.$$
nodes.callout_body: 函数$f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$是黎曼可积的，当且仅当对任意$\varepsilon>0$,存在一个$\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$使得任意满足$\lambda(P'),\lambda(P'')<\delta_{\varepsilon}$的划分$(P',\xi'),(P'',\xi'')$都有$$|S_f(P',\xi')-S_f(P'',\xi'')|<\varepsilon$$

nodes.source_note: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别
nodes.english_source_note: Riemann Integral and Criteria for Integrability
nodes.callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#7
nodes.english_title: Theorem 2.1.2: Squeeze Theorem for Riemann Integrability
nodes.statement_en: A function $f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$ is Riemann integrable if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exist two Riemann integrable functions $\alpha_{\varepsilon},\beta_{\varepsilon}$ such that $$\alpha_{\varepsilon}\leq f\leq \beta_{\varepsilon}$$ and $$\left|\int_a^b \alpha_{\varepsilon}(x)-\beta_{\varepsilon}\,dx\right|<\varepsilon.$$
key_techniques: approximation by integrable upper and lower functions
prerequisites: basic properties of the Riemann integral
nodes.callout_body: 函数$f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$黎曼可积，当且仅当对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在两个黎曼可积函数$\alpha_{\varepsilon},\beta_{\varepsilon}$满足$$\alpha_{\varepsilon}\leq f\leq \beta_{\varepsilon}$$并且$$\left|\int_a^b \alpha_{\varepsilon}(x)-\beta_{\varepsilon}\,dx\right|<\varepsilon$$

nodes.callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#8
nodes.statement_en: A bounded function $f$ is Riemann integrable on the closed interval $[a,b]$ if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$ such that for every partition with $\lambda(P)<\delta_{\varepsilon}$, one has $$\sum_{i=1}^n \omega_f([x_{i-1},x_i])(x_i-x_{i-1})<\varepsilon.$$
nodes.callout_body: 一个有界函数$f$在闭区间$[a,b]$上黎曼可积，当且仅当对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在一个$\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$使得对任意的满足$\lambda(P)<\delta_{\varepsilon}$都有$$\sum_{i=1}^n \omega_f([x_{i-1},x_i])(x_i-x_{i-1})<\varepsilon$$

nodes.source_note: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别
nodes.english_source_note: Riemann Integral and Criteria for Integrability
nodes.callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#9
nodes.english_title: Darboux Equivalent Condition for Riemann Integrability
nodes.statement_en: A function $f$ on the rectangle $I_{a,b}\subset \mathbb{R}^n$ is Riemann integrable if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a partition $P_{\varepsilon}$ such that $$\sum_{k=1}^{n_{\varepsilon}} (M_k-m_k)|I_k|<\varepsilon,$$ where $\{I_k\}_{k=1}^{n_{\varepsilon}}$ are the subrectangles induced by the partition $P_{\varepsilon}$, and $M_k,m_k$ are respectively the supremum and infimum of $f$ on $I_k$.
nodes.callout_body: 长方体$I_{a,b}\subset \mathbb{R}^n$上的函数$f$黎曼可积，等价于，对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在划分$P_{\varepsilon}$从而使得$$\sum_{k=1}^{n_{\varepsilon}} (M_k-m_k)|I_k|$$其中$\{I_k\}_{k=1}^{n_{\varepsilon}}$是划分$P_{\varepsilon}$产生的子长方体（$\mathbb{R}$上的时候称之为区间，有时候为了方便都统一称之为区间），$M_k,m_k$分别是$I_k$上函数$f$的上确界和下确界。

nodes.statement_en: A bounded function $f$ on the closed interval $[a,b]$ is Riemann integrable if and only if $f$ is continuous almost everywhere on this closed interval.

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#2
nodes.english_title: Theorem 1.1: Identity Theorem for Continuous Functions
nodes.statement_en: Let $f,g:X\to Y$ be continuous maps from a topological space $X$ to a Hausdorff space $Y$. If $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in Z$$ for some dense subset $Z\subset X$, then $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in X.$$
key_techniques: closedness of the diagonal in a Hausdorff space
nodes.callout_body: 假设映射$f,g:X\to Y$是从拓扑空间$X$到$Y$的两个连续映射，其中$Y$是Hausdroff的。如果两个函数$$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in Z$$其中$Z\subset X$是一个稠密子集。那么$$f(x)=g(x),\forall x\in X$$

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#3
nodes.english_title: Theorem 1.2: A Variant of the Identity Theorem for Continuous Functions
nodes.statement_en: Let $f,g:X\to Y$ be continuous maps from a topological space $X$ to a Hausdorff ordered topological space $Y$, and assume the order relation is compatible with the topology in the sense that $\{(y_1,y_2)\in Y\times Y:y_1\leq y_2\}$ is closed. If $$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in Z$$ for some dense subset $Z\subset X$, then $$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in X.$$
nodes.callout_body:
假设映射$f,g:X\to Y$是从拓扑空间$X$到$Y$的两个连续映射，其中$Y$是Hausdroff的有序拓扑空间,并且其上的序关系"$\leq$"与拓扑是相容的，即集合$\{(y_1,y_2)\in Y\times Y:y_1\leq y_2\}$是一个闭集。

那么如果两个函数$$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in Z$$其中$Z\subset X$是一个稠密子集。那么$$f(x)\leq g(x),\forall x\in X$$

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#4
nodes.statement_en: If a holomorphic function $f$ on an open connected subset $U$ of the complex plane is equal to $0$ on some subset $S\subset U$ having an accumulation point in $U$, then $f$ is identically zero on all of $U$.
nodes.callout_body: 如果定义在复平面上的全纯函数$f$在连通开集子集$U$的某个含有聚点(极限点)的某个子集$S\subset U$上等于0,并且聚点在$U$当中，那么函数在整个$U$上等于0.

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#5
nodes.statement_en: Consider $$g(z):= \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{z}\right).$$ The function $g$ has an essential singularity at $0$, and $g\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)=0$ for all $n\in\mathbb{Z}\setminus\{0\}$. The zeros accumulate at $0$, but on the punctured disk $D_r(0)\setminus\{0\}$ the point $0$ is not in the domain. Hence one cannot conclude that $g$ is identically zero when the accumulation point of zeros lies outside the domain.
nodes.callout_body:
$$g(z):= \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{z}\right)$$
函数$g$在0的位置是一个本性奇点,然后函数在$z = \frac{1}{n},n\in\mathbb{Z}\setminus \{0\}$上都是零点，其聚点是$0$.函数$g$在开连通区域$D_r(0)\setminus\{0\}$上全纯,0虽然是聚点但是$0 \not \in D_r(0)\setminus\{0\}$.在这种情况下，聚点不在开连通区域里面的时候，我们不能得到函数是0函数的结论。

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#6
nodes.english_title: Proposition 2.1.3: Zeros of a One-Variable Complex Analytic Function Are Isolated on an Open Connected Set
nodes.statement_en: Let $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$ be a nonzero holomorphic function on a nonempty open connected set $U$, and let $z_0\in U$ be a zero of $f$. Then there exists a disk $D(z_0,r)$ such that $z_0$ is the only zero of $f$ in that disk.
key_techniques: factorization by the order of vanishing
nodes.callout_body: $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$是定义在非空开连通子集$U$上的**非零**全纯函数，并且$z_0\in U$是其一个零点，那么存在一个圆盘$D(z_0,r)$使得函数在圆盘里面，除了$z_0$以外没有任何其他零点。

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#7
nodes.statement_en: If the domain is not connected, for example $U=A\cup B$ with $A,B$ disjoint open sets, define $$f(z):=\begin{cases}0&z \in A\\ 1&z \in B\end{cases}.$$ Then $f$ is holomorphic on $U$ and is not identically zero, but its zeros are not isolated.
key_techniques: failure of isolated zeros without connectedness
prerequisites: open sets in the complex plane
nodes.callout_body:
假设不是连通的一个开集,比如$U=A\cup B$,其中$A,B$是两个不相交的开集。
$$f(z):=\begin{cases}0&z \in A\\ 1&z \in B\end{cases}$$
此时函数在$U$上全纯，并且不恒等于0，但是零点也非孤立。

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#8
nodes.english_title: Proposition 2.1.5: Zeros of a One-Variable Real Analytic Function Are Isolated on an Open Interval
nodes.statement_en: Let $f:I\to \mathbb{R}$ be a nonzero real analytic function on an open interval $I$. Then all zeros of $f$ in $I$ are isolated.
nodes.callout_body: 令$f:I\to \mathbb{R}$是一个定义在开区间$I$上的一元非零实解析函数，则$f$在$I$上的所有零点都是孤立的。

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#9
nodes.english_title: Counterexample 2.1.6: A Nonzero Smooth Real Function Whose Zeros Are Dense on an Open Interval
nodes.statement_en: Consider $$f(x):=\begin{cases}e^{-1/x}&x>0\\0&x\leq0\end{cases}.$$ This is a smooth function because all derivatives at $x=0$ exist and are equal to $0$. However, on $\mathbb{R}$ its zeros are not isolated, so this shows that a nonzero smooth function need not have isolated zeros and therefore need not be real analytic.
key_techniques: flat smooth function at a point
nodes.callout_body: 考虑函数$$f(x):=\begin{cases}e^{-1/x}&x>0\\0&x\leq0\end{cases}$$这是一个光滑函数，因为函数$f$在$x=0$处任意阶可导，且导数为$0$但是显然函数在$\mathbb{R}$这个开区间上，零点并不是孤立的。从这里也可以反推，此函数一定不是$\mathbb{R}$上的实解析函数。

nodes.source_note: identity theorem
nodes.english_source_note: Identity Theorem
nodes.callout_id: identity theorem#10
nodes.statement_en: Let $f$ be holomorphic on a connected open set $U\subset \mathbb{C}^n$. If $f$ vanishes identically on some connected open subset $S\subset U$, then $f$ vanishes identically on all of $U$.
nodes.callout_body: 全纯函数$f$在连通开集$U\subset \mathbb{C}^n$上的某个连通开子集$S\subset U$上恒等于0，那么函数在整个$U$上等于0.

strategies.strategy_name_en: Identity theorem reduction from a subset
strategies.summary_en: To prove that two sufficiently regular functions on a domain are identical, it can be enough to verify equality on a smaller subset. Strong regularity lets local or partial information determine the global function.
strategies.applicability: Applies when working with classes of functions whose values on a dense set, accumulation set, or other determining subset uniquely determine the whole function.

nodes.statement_en: If $f \in \mathscr{F}_a$, then for every $0<b<a$, its Fourier transform satisfies $$\widehat{f}(\xi)\lesssim_{b,f,\alpha}e^{-2\pi b|\xi|}$$ for all $\xi \in \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.callout_body: 如果函数$f \in \mathscr{F}_a$那么对于任意的$0<b<a$其傅里叶变换都满足$$\widehat{f}(\xi)\lesssim_{b,f,\alpha}e^{-2\pi b|\xi|}$$对任意$\xi \in \mathbb{R}$成立。

nodes.callout_body: 如果我有一个实函数$f\in L^1(\mathbb{R})$，其傅里叶变换$\widehat{f}$满足和上面一样的快速衰减的条件$$\widehat{f}(\xi)\lesssim_{b,f}e^{-2\pi a|\xi|}$$是不是说这个函数一定可以拓展为复平面上的带状区域$S_a$上的一个全纯函数了？

nodes.callout_id: 实分析的复办法#9
nodes.statement_en: Let $f:\mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{C}$ be a function of subpolynomial growth, meaning that $f(n)\lesssim_{\varepsilon,f} n^{\varepsilon}$ for every natural number $n$ and every $\varepsilon>0$. Let $F(s)$ denote the Dirichlet series on the half-plane $\{\operatorname{Re}(s)>1\}$ given by $$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{f(n)}{n^s}.$$ Then for every positive non-integer real number $x$ and every $\sigma>1$, one has $$\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)=\frac{1}{2\pi i }\lim_{T\to \infty}\int_{\sigma-iT}^{\sigma+iT}F(s)\frac{x^s}{s}\,ds.$$
nodes.callout_body: $f:\mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{C}$是一个亚多项式增长的函数，也就是说满足$f(n)\lesssim_{\varepsilon,f} n^{\varepsilon}$对任意自然数$n$以及$\varepsilon>0$。令$F(s)$表示在右半平面$\{\text{Re}(s)>1\}$上的Dirichlet级数$$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{f(s)}{n^s}$$那么对于任意非整数的正实数$x$，以及$\sigma>1$成立公式$$\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)=\frac{1}{2\pi i }\lim_{T\to \infty}\int_{\sigma-iT}^{\sigma+iT}F(s)\frac{x^s}{s}\,ds$$

nodes.callout_body: $A,B$是整数集的两个不相交的有限子集，$a,b$是两个正整数，此外$$A\cup B \subset (A-a)\cup (B+b)$$其中$A-a:=\{x-a:x \in A\},B+b:=\{x+b:x \in B\}$证明$$a|A|=b|B|$$

nodes.callout_id: 分析学基本方法目录1#2
nodes.statement_en: Show that $$x=0\\iff |x|<\\varepsilon,\\forall \\varepsilon>0.$$ In particular, prove that if $$|x|<\\varepsilon\\quad \\forall \\varepsilon>0,$$ then \(x=0\).
prerequisites: absolute value on the real line
basic order properties of real numbers
nodes.callout_body:
$$x=0\iff |x|<\varepsilon,\forall \varepsilon>0$$我们主要看右边的部分，为何$|x|<\varepsilon,\forall \varepsilon\implies x=0$。
1. 在实数轴上满足$|x|<1$的数可以用区间$x\in (-1,1)$表示。
2. 在实数轴上满足$|x|<\frac{1}{2}$的数可以用区间$x\in (-1/2,1/2)$表示。
3. 在实数轴上满足$|x|<\frac{1}{1000}$的数可以用区间$x\in (-1/1000,1/1000)$表示。

那么有什么数是可以被包含在任意的$(-\varepsilon,\varepsilon)$区间当中的呢？只有$0$。

nodes.source_note: 分析学基本方法目录1
nodes.english_source_note: Basic Methods in Analysis I
nodes.callout_id: 分析学基本方法目录1#3
nodes.statement_en: Prove the following implications: 1. $$\\forall \\varepsilon>0,\\ x<a+\\varepsilon\\implies x\\le a.$$ 2. $$b>0\	ext{ and }(\\forall \\varepsilon>0,\\ x<a+b\\varepsilon)\\implies x\\le a.$$ 3. $$\\forall \\varepsilon>0,\\ x>a-\\varepsilon\\implies x\\ge a.$$ 4. $$b>0\	ext{ and }(\\forall \\varepsilon>0,\\ x>a-b\\varepsilon)\\implies x\\ge a.$$ 5. $$\\forall \\varepsilon>0,\\ |x-a|<\\varepsilon\\implies x=a.$$ 6. $$b>0\	ext{ and }(\\forall \\varepsilon>0,\\ |x-a|<b\\varepsilon)\\implies x=a.$$
nodes.callout_body:
1. $$\forall \varepsilon>0,x<a+\varepsilon\implies x\leq a$$我们可以理解为，任何一个实数如果满足$x>a$那么必然对于某个$\varepsilon_0>0$不满足左边的命题，从而使得$x\geq a+\varepsilon_0$。
2. $$b>0\text{ and }(\forall \varepsilon>0,x<a+b\varepsilon)\implies x\leq a$$我们可以理解为，任何一个实数如果满足$x>a$那么必然对于某个$\varepsilon_0>0$不满足左边的命题，从而使得$x\geq a+b\varepsilon_0$。
3. $$\forall \varepsilon>0,x>a-\varepsilon\implies x\geq a$$我们可以理解为，任何一个实数如果满足$x<a$那么必然对于某个$\varepsilon_0>0$不满足左边的命题，从而使得$x\leq a-\varepsilon_0$。
4. $$b>0\text{ and }(\forall \varepsilon>0,x>a-b\varepsilon)\implies x\geq a$$我们可以理解为，任何一个实数如果满足$x<a$那么必然对于某个$\varepsilon_0>0$不满足左边的命题，从而使得$x\leq a-b\varepsilon_0$。
5. $$\forall \varepsilon>0,|x-a|<\varepsilon\implies x= a$$我们可以理解为，任何一个实数如果满足$x\neq a$那么必然对于某个$\varepsilon_0>0$不满足左边的命题，从而使得$|x-a|\geq \varepsilon_0$。
6. $$b>0\text{ and }(\forall \varepsilon>0,|x-a|<b\varepsilon)\implies x= a$$我们可以理解为，任何一个实数如果满足$x\neq a$那么必然对于某个$\varepsilon_0>0$不满足左边的命题，从而使得$|x-a|\geq b\varepsilon_0$。

nodes.english_title: Example 1.1.3: Necessary Condition for a Local Extremum of a Function
nodes.statement_en: If \(x_0\) is a local maximum point of a differentiable function \(f(x)\), prove that $$f'(x_0)=0.$$
nodes.callout_body: 如果$x_0$是函数$f(x)$的一个局部极大值点，也就是说在$x_0$的邻域$I_{x_0}$（一个包含$x_0$的区间）当中$y\in I_{x_0}$都有$f(y)\leq f(x_0)$。我们从逼近的角度上来说，如果$h>0,x_0+h\in I_{x_0}$，如果$x_0$是局部极大值点，那么$$\frac{f(x_0+h)-f(x_0)}{h}=f'(x_0)+o(1)\leq 0$$那么两边取极限以后（此处回忆“命题0.2”会更容易理解）得到$$f'(x_0)\leq 0$$如果$h<0,x_0+h\in I_{x_0}$,如果$x_0$是局部极大值点，那么$$\frac{f(x_0+h)-f(x_0)}{h}=f'(x_0)+o(1)\geq 0$$那么两边取极限以后（此处回忆“命题0.2”会更容易理解）得到$$f'(x_0)\geq 0$$于是得到$$f'(x_0)=0$$这件事告诉我们，逼近函数$f(x)$的线性函数的“斜率”为0的点（一元函数图像上的切线与x轴平行的时候），**有可能**（只是必要条件，并非充要条件）是函数的局部极值点。

nodes.statement_en: Compute the limit $$\\lim_{x\	o 0}\\frac{\\sin(x)}{x}.$$
key_techniques: function approximation by a linear term
nodes.callout_body: 求函数极限$$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sin(x)}{x}$$此函数极限势必关系到函数$\sin(x)$在$x=0$处的性质，那么函数在$x=0$处的极限又如何研究呢？经过上面的分析我们要分析逼近$\sin(x)$的线性函数，以及逼近误差。我们发现$$\sin(x)=x+o(x)$$于是函数$\frac{\sin(x)}{x}$在$x=0$的小邻域当中具有逼近$$\frac{\sin(x)}{x}=1+o(1)$$这便意味着此函数在$x\to 0$处的极限为1.

strategies.english_title: Overview of the Idea of an Epsilon of Room
strategies.strategy_name_en: Epsilon of Room
strategies.summary_en: When a target object \(x_0\) is hard to study directly, replace it with a family of better-understood approximating objects \(x_{\\varepsilon}\) together with analogous statements \(S_{\\varepsilon}\). If proving all \(S_{\\varepsilon}\) implies the desired statement \(S_0\) for \(x_0\), then the original problem is solved indirectly.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a mathematical object is inaccessible directly but can be approximated by simpler objects whose properties can be controlled uniformly in \(\\varepsilon\).
strategies.callout_body:
假设我要研究一个对象$x_0$，以及与这个对象有关的一个数学命题$S_0$，我们这样一组对象简写为$(S_0,x_0)$。但是我们无法直接理解$x_0$这个对象，我们缺乏直接对$x_0$进行操作从而解决与之相关的$S_0$的技术和条件。不过我们发现一个我们已经很好地理解的一系列对象$x_{\varepsilon}$，关于$x_{\varepsilon}$也有一个类似的命题$S_{\varepsilon}$，我们把这一组对象简写为$(x_{\varepsilon},S_{\varepsilon})$。

这个时候，如果$(x_{\varepsilon},S_{\varepsilon})$恰好是一个足够好的对象，以至于我们可以从$$(x_{\varepsilon},S_{\varepsilon})\forall \varepsilon\implies (x_0,S_0)$$那么原来的问题也就解决了。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Study a Limit Object Through an Approximating Sequence
strategies.summary_en: If an object \(x\) can be represented as the limit of a sequence \(x_n\), then properties of \(x\) can often be studied by analyzing corresponding properties of the approximating sequence \(x_n\). This shifts the problem from a possibly abstract object to concrete finite-stage approximations.
strategies.applicability: Applies whenever the target object is given or naturally realized as the limit of a sequence and the finite approximants are easier to compute or estimate.
strategies.callout_body: 如果我们有一个对象$x$，它可以表达为某个序列$x_n$的极限。如果我们要研究$x$的某个性质，我们不妨研究$x_n$这个序列的有关性质。

strategies.english_title: Core Idea of the Above Method
strategies.strategy_name_en: Upper-Bound Simplification for Sums and Products
strategies.summary_en: To study a complicated sum or product \(S_n\), seek a simpler upper bound \(U_n\) with acceptable error and a more tractable expression. This may come either from an exact recognizable form or from a controlled comparison such as integral bounds or telescoping transformations.
strategies.applicability: Applies when direct evaluation of a sum or product is difficult, but a simpler comparison object can still reveal the needed asymptotic or quantitative information.
strategies.callout_body:
如果我们需要给一个乘积，或者一个和$S_n$一个函数表示的上界$U_n$，使得$$S_n\leq U_n$$对$n>M$都成立。通常来说$U_n$的表达和性质要比$S_n$要简单很多，这也是为什么上界估计是有用的原因:我们用一个有误差但可以接受的上界换来一个一窥复杂的$S_n$的特定信息的机会。

为了得到这个$U_n$我们其中一种主要的想法是：
1. $S_n$是否可以本身就非常容易求乘积或者和，并且乘积或者和是对我们而言比较简单或者熟悉的形式？比如假设$S_n=H_n$是调和数，或者其他什么我们很熟悉的特殊函数，亦或者就是多项式等等。
2. 如果第一个做不到，我们的想法是，是否可以通过放缩得到一个$S_n'$使得$S_n'$与$S_n$之间的误差符合要求，同时$S_n'$具有一个简单或者熟悉的表达式。比如积分放缩，寻求的就是积分的形式是对我们而言是简单的或者非常熟悉的。再比如“裂项求和”就是属于这种类型的形式。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Convexity-Based Integral Estimate
strategies.summary_en: Use convexity, often via the Hermite-Hadamard inequality, to compare discrete sums with integrals over unit intervals. This gives improved lower bounds for sums compared with using monotonicity alone, though usually without changing the order of the error term.
strategies.applicability: Applies when estimating sums of values of a convex function, especially when monotonicity-based integral comparison is available and a slightly sharper bound is desired.
strategies.callout_body:
简单的积分估计本质上是一种[[逐项估计]]，我们利用函数的单调性，然后把函数在整数处的取值放缩为函数在长度为1的区间上的积分。按照相同的思路，有时候我们也可以利用函数的凸性来把函数逐项放缩为长度为1的区间上的积分。

其主要参考的命题为：
对于在区间$[a,b]$上凸的函数而言，对任意$x_1,x_2\in [a,b]$并且满足$x_1<x_2$都有$$\frac{f(x_1)+f(x_2)}{2}\geq \frac{1}{x_2-x_1}\int_{x_1}^{x_2} f(x)\,dx$$
* 参考[[Hermite-Hadamard不等式与函数凸性]].

那么对每个区间利用这样的结果进行放缩，我们得到$$\sum_{k=1}^{n-1} \frac{f(x_k)+f(x_{k+1})}{2}(x_{k+1}-x_k)\geq \int_{x_1}^{x_n}f(x)\,dx$$如果$x_k=k$那么以上结果可以等价于$$\sum_{k=1}^n f(k)\geq \frac{f(1)+f(n)}{2}+\int_{1}^{n}f(x)\,dx$$

---
这种估计，对于单调凸函数而言是对和的下界估计的精度改进，这种改进不是本质的，误差级别不会变但是下界要比单纯利用单调性会好上一点。

比如我们假设$f$是严格单调减少的，单纯利用单调性得到的下界估计是$$\sum_{k=1}^n f(k)\geq f(n)+\int_{1}^n f(x)\,dx$$相对于利用凸性得到的下界估计，由于严格单调减少性$$\frac{f(1)+f(n)}{2}\geq f(n)$$于是我们知道由凸性得到的下界估计会好上一些，但不本质。

同样的道理，如果我们假设函数严格单调增加，那么单纯利用单调性得到的下界估计是$$\sum_{k=1}^n f(k)>f(1)+\int_{1}^n f(x)\,dx$$由于严格增加性，于是$$\frac{f(1)+f(n)}{2}\geq f(1)$$因此由凸性得到的下界估计会更好一些。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Summation by Parts Strategy
strategies.summary_en: When a partial sum has the form $$S_{M,N}=\\sum_{n=M}^N a_n b_n,$$ and \(a_n\) has manageable differences while partial sums of \(b_n\) are accessible, estimate \(S_{M,N}\) indirectly through the partial sums \(B_N\\) and the differences \(a_{n+1}-a_n\).
strategies.applicability: Applies to weighted sums where one factor has simple discrete variation and the other has useful partial-sum information, as in Dirichlet-type arguments.
strategies.callout_body:
当我们处理某个部分和$S_{M,N}$的时候，如果我们发现被求和对象可以写成乘积的形式以至于部分和$S_{M,N}$可以写成$$S_{M,N}:=\sum_{n=M}^N a_nb_n$$并且我们假设其中$a_n,b_n$满足假设:
1. 其中形式较为简单的对象$a_n$，其差分序列$a_{n+1}-a_n$是较为简单的。
2. 其中$b_n$的形式虽然较为复杂，但是其部分和$B_N:=\sum_{n=M}^N b_n$对我们而言是熟悉的(通过其他方式获取到的，或者已知估计的)

此时我们可以借助部分和$B_N$以及差分$a_{n+1}-a_n$的估计来间接地得到$S_N$的估计。

strategies.strategy_name_en: An Epsilon of Room
strategies.summary_en: To prove a target statement \(S_0\) about an object \(x_0\), replace it by a more tractable statement \(S_{\\varepsilon}\) about a perturbed object \(x_{\\varepsilon}\). If \(S_{\\varepsilon}\) holds for every \(\\varepsilon>0\) and implies \(S_0\) in the limit, then the original statement follows.
strategies.applicability: Applies when the original object or statement is hard to handle directly, but small perturbations create extra structure, flexibility, or available tools.
strategies.callout_body:
1. 要证明一个命题$S_0$,这个命题涉及一个对象$x_0$(比如一个值，或者一个函数等等)
2. 不妨证明一个命题$S_{\varepsilon}$以及一个对象$x_{\varepsilon}$，这个命题更容易操作(意味着可以下手的工具更多)，从而比原来的问题更容易处理。
3. 如果$S_{\varepsilon}$对任意$\varepsilon >0$成立，它能导出$S_0$。

strategies.english_title: Version 2: Convert an Infinite Problem into a Finite Problem
strategies.strategy_name_en: Convert an Infinite Problem into a Finite Problem
strategies.summary_en: Instead of proving a statement \(S_{\\infty}\) directly, prove a weaker but finite version such as \(S_N\) or \(S_h\), involving a fixed finite parameter. If this finite statement holds uniformly for sufficiently arbitrary \(N\) or \(h\), then the original infinite statement is established.
strategies.applicability: Applies when an infinite, asymptotic, or limiting problem can be approximated or reduced to finite truncations, discretizations, or fixed-parameter cases.
strategies.callout_body:
1. 如果要证明一个命题$S_{\infty}$，此命题涉及一个对象$x_{\infty}$。
2. 我们不妨去证明一个更弱的命题$S_{N}$或者$S_h$，这个命题涉及一个对象$x_{N}$或者$x_h$,这是一个有限的固定的问题。但是如果这个有限的问题，对于一定程度上任意的参数$N$或者$h$成立那么原来的命题被证明。

strategies.english_title: Version 3: First Prove It for Better-Behaved Objects, Then Pass to the Original One
strategies.strategy_name_en: Prove First on Better-Behaved Objects, Then Pass to the Limit
strategies.summary_en: Replace the original object \(x_0\) in the statement \(S_0\) by a better-behaved object \(x_{\\varepsilon}\), and prove the corresponding statement \(S_{\\varepsilon}\). If this works for every \(\\varepsilon\) and one can transfer the result back to the original setting, then \(S_0\) follows.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a rough, singular, or poorly structured object can be approximated by smoother or more regular objects for which the argument is easier.
strategies.callout_body:
1. 命题$S_0$涉及的对象$x_0$如果我们替换为一个性质更好的对象$x_{\varepsilon}$,这个命题是否还能成立。
2. 这个新的命题我们称之为$S_{\varepsilon}$.如果这个新的命题是成立的，并且对任意$\varepsilon$成立，并且我们可以把新的命题过渡到原有命题上(过渡的手法多种多样)，问题就解决了。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Use the Cauchy Necessary Condition via Successive Differences
strategies.summary_en: To show a sequence does not converge, test a necessary condition for being Cauchy: if $a_n$ converges, then $|a_{n+1}-a_n| \to 0$. Assume this holds and derive a contradiction by computing or estimating the successive differences.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a sequence has an explicit formula and the difference between consecutive terms is easy to analyze.
strategies.callout_body: 参考[[柯西收敛判别#^9993bc]]，序列成为柯西列的一个必要条件是差分的绝对值$|a_{n+1}-a_n|$收敛到0。那么序列$\sin(n)$满足这一条吗？我们不妨假设它满足，看看这会发生什么。

strategies.callout_id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#6
strategies.strategy_name_en: Separate the Range into Two Positively Distanced Sets Across Periods
strategies.summary_en: Exploit periodicity by choosing two subsets $A,B$ of the range with positive mutual distance, then show that in each period there are integers landing in domain intervals mapped into $A$ and $B$. This yields two subsequences whose function values stay uniformly apart, preventing convergence.
strategies.applicability: Applies to nonconstant periodic functions sampled along integers or other discrete sets when each period contains sample points in separated regions of the graph.
strategies.callout_body: 由于函数的周期性，我们只要能够在$\sin(x)$的值域$[-1,1]$当中分离出两个集合$A,B$然后保证$$d(A,B):=\inf\{|x-y|:x\in A,y\in B\}>0$$然后在每个周期内保证$A,B$对应的定义域中的集集合$I_{A,k},I_{B,k}$当中各自至少包含一个整数$n_k,m_k$那么我们就可以保证$$|\sin(n_k)-\sin(m_k)|\geq d(A,B)>0,\forall k\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}$$我们这里可以加强命题，只需要考虑如果$|I_{A,k}|,|I_{B,k}|\geq 1$，那么其中一定会包含整数。

nodes.statement_en: Assume $a>0$ and define the sequence $$x_{n+1}:=\frac{1}{2}\left(x_n+\frac{a}{x_n}\right).$$ 1. Prove that under the condition $x_1>0$, we have $x_n\to \sqrt{a}$. 2. Estimate the absolute error $e_n:=x_n-\sqrt{a}$ and give an upper bound for $|e_n|$.
nodes.callout_body:

1. 证明在$x_1> 0$的条件下$x_n\to \sqrt{a}$。
2. 估计绝对误差$e_n:=x_n-\sqrt{a}$,给出$|e_n|$的上界估计。

nodes.callout_id: Re0微积分1:用牛顿迭代法求算术平方根#4
nodes.statement_en: Consider the unit circle $S^1$ and its circumference, denoted by a quantity $a$. Suppose we know that the unit circle can be approximated arbitrarily well by inscribed regular polygons. 1. Define the set of inscribed regular polygons as $\Omega=\{p_1,...,p_n,...\}$. 2. The property $P$ is perimeter, and the perimeter of the inscribed regular $n$-gon $p_n$ is $$L_n=2n\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{n}\right).$$ 3. Measuring closeness by the absolute difference of real numbers, we obtain $$\forall \varepsilon >0,\exists p_n\in \Omega\text{ s.t. }|L_n-a|<\varepsilon.$$
nodes.callout_body:
假设我们现在有一个对象$S^1$为单位圆周，我们想要研究$S^1$的称之为周长的性质，即一个数量$a$.假设我们已经知道，我们可以用单位圆周的内接正多变形去任意逼近单位圆周。
1. 此处定义圆内接正多边形的集合为$\Omega=\{p_1,...,p_n,...\}$.
2. 这里的性质$P$,就是图形的周长。单位圆内接正$n$边形$p_n$的周长为$$L_n=2n\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{n}\right)$$
3. 此处衡量两个对象周长的相近的程度的装置自然就是实数差的绝对值，因为周长本质上还是实数。于是我们相当于得到了$$\forall \varepsilon >0,\exists p_n\in \Omega\text{ s.t. }|L_n-a|<\varepsilon$$

nodes.callout_id: Re0微积分1:用牛顿迭代法求算术平方根#7
nodes.statement_en: Let $y_n=\frac{(-1)^n}{n}$ be the sequence whose limit is to be discussed. By examining points on the real line, one finds that only $0$ satisfies the geometric interpretation of limit. For example, if $\varepsilon_0 =1/3$, then $$I_{\varepsilon_0}(0)=(-1/3,1/3)$$ contains infinitely many terms of the sequence, while outside the interval there are only the three terms $-1,1/2,-1/3$. Most importantly, this geometric property holds for every choice of radius $\varepsilon$.
nodes.callout_body: 假设$y_n=\frac{(-1)^n}{n}$是我们要讨论极限的序列，我们遍寻所有实数轴上点(实际上在实数轴上中一目了然)，发现只有0能满足这样的几何意义。比如我们令$\varepsilon_0 =1/3$,于是我们的对称区间就是$$I_{\varepsilon_0}(0)=(-1/3,1/3)$$当中包含无穷多个序列的点，然而在区间外部，只有$-1,1/2,-1/3$三个序列的点。最重要的是，这个点的特殊之处在于，无论我们对称区间的半径$\varepsilon$取多少，这个几何性质皆成立。

nodes.source_note: Re0微积分1：用牛顿迭代法求算术平方根
nodes.english_source_note: Re0 Calculus 1: Arithmetic Square Roots by Newton Iteration
nodes.callout_id: Re0微积分1:用牛顿迭代法求算术平方根#8
nodes.statement_en: It is important to note that the condition is that for every symmetric interval $I_{\varepsilon}(L)$ centered at some real number $L$, there are only finitely many terms outside the interval, rather than merely infinitely many terms inside it. This difference is illustrated by the sequence $$b_n=\begin{cases}1&\text{n is even}\\ -1&\text{n is odd}\end{cases}.$$ This sequence has no limit. If the center $x\neq 1,-1$, then for sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, the interval $I_{\varepsilon}(x)$ contains no terms of $b_n$. If $x=1$, then outside $I_{\varepsilon}(x)$ there are always infinitely many terms with $b_n=-1$; similarly for $x=-1$. Hence no point satisfies the geometric property, so the sequence has no limit.
nodes.callout_body:
一定要注意这里强调的是，以某个实数$L$为中心任意半径的对称区间$I_{\varepsilon}(L)$的**外部只有有限多个元素，而不是内部有无穷个序列的元素**。这其中的差别可以从下面的例子当中看出来:

定义为$$b_n=\begin{cases}1&\text{n 是偶数}\\ -1&\text{n 是奇数}\end{cases}$$的序列没有极限。因为如果我们的对称区间$I_{\varepsilon}(x)$的中心$x\neq 1,-1$的话，只要$\varepsilon$足够小，那么其内部就不会包含任何序列$b_n$的元素，这就无法满足上面的几何性质。但是如果$x=1$,那么$I_{\varepsilon}(x)$其外部始终存在无穷多个$b_n=-1$,反过来$x=-1$也是如此.因此不存在一个点满足这样的几何性质，因此该序列没有极限。

nodes.statement_en: Assume the limits of two sequences exist, with $x_n\to a$ and $y_n\to b$. Then: 1. Addition: $x_n+y_n \to a+b$. 2. Subtraction: $x_n-y_n \to a-b$. 3. Multiplication: $x_ny_n \to ab$. 4. Division: if $b\neq 0$ and $\frac{x_n}{y_n}$ is defined, then $\frac{x_n}{y_n}\to \frac{a}{b}$.
nodes.callout_body:
假设序列两个序列的极限存在，并且$x_n\to a,y_n\to b$，那么一定有:
1. 加法：序列$x_n+y_n \to a+b$
2. 减法:序列$x_n-y_n \to a-b$
3. 乘法:序列$x_ny_n \to ab$
4. 除法:在$b\neq 0$的情况下，并且序列$\frac{x_n}{y_n}$有意义的情况下，$\frac{x_n}{y_n}\to \frac{a}{b}$

strategies.strategy_name_en: Approximate a complicated object by simpler objects
strategies.summary_en: To study a property of a complicated object, replace it by a family of simpler known objects that approximate it arbitrarily well. Then transfer the analysis of the property to those approximating objects.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a target object can be approximated by simpler objects in a way relevant to the property being studied.
strategies.callout_body: 当我们想要研究一个复杂的对象$\text{A}$的某个性质$P$的时候，不妨想个办法找到某个由一些我们已知的并且认为相对简单的对象构成的集合$\Omega$,使得$A$可以由$\Omega$当中的元素任意逼近。那么我们可以从研究$A$的性质$P$,转而研究$\Omega$当中元素的性质$P$。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Replace by a Better-Behaved Approximation with Controlled Error
strategies.summary_en: If one can find a modified quantity $S_n'$ whose asymptotic expansion is easier to derive than that of $S_n$, then it is enough to compare $S_n$ and $S_n'$. When the total discrepancy is controlled by $O(g(n))$, at the target precision, the two quantities have the same final asymptotic expansion.
strategies.applicability: Use this when a direct asymptotic analysis is difficult, but a suitably bounded approximation, comparison, or squeezing produces a simpler expression with the same asymptotic accuracy.
strategies.callout_body: 如果你发现一个$S_n'$其形式比$S_n$更好得到渐近展开，比如说对$S_n$做某种放缩，只要放缩整体的误差是被$O(g(n))$控制起来的(这里表示目标误差精度)，那么最终的渐近展开是相同的。

nodes.statement_en: Let $f_n$ be a sequence of measurable functions on a measure space $(X, \mathcal{F}, \mu)$. Write $E_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X f_n\,d\mu$ and $V_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X (f_n-E_{\mu}f_n)^2\,d\mu$. If $$E_{\mu}(f_n) \to C$$ and $$\sum_{n\geq 1} V_{\mu}(f_n) < \infty,$$ then $f_n \to C$ almost everywhere on $X$.

nodes.english_source_note: Riemann Sum Limits on Integer Sets of Density p
nodes.callout_id: 渐近密度为p的整数子集上黎曼和的极限#1
nodes.statement_en:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a subset of the positive integers, and for any $0\leq a\leq b\leq 1$ define
$$S_n(a,b):=\#\{k\in\mathcal{A}:an\leq k\leq bn \}.$$ 
Assume that the limit of $\frac{S_n(0,1)}{n}$ exists and equals $p$. Prove:

1. If $0<a<b<1$, then $\lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{S_n(a,b)}{n}$ exists, and determine its value.
2. If $f$ is Riemann integrable on $[0,1]$, prove that
$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{k\leq n,k\in \mathcal{A}}f\left(\frac{k}{n}\right)=p\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx.$$
nodes.callout_body:
设$\mathcal{A}$为正整数集的子集，对任意$0\leq a\leq b\leq 1$定义$$S_n(a,b):=\#\{k\in\mathcal{A}:an\leq k\leq bn \}$$若$\frac{S_n(0,1)}{n}$的极限存在且为$p$，证明：

1. 若$0<a<b<1$证明$\lim_{n\to +\infty}\frac{S_n(a,b)}{n}$存在并求其值。
2. 若$f$在$[0,1]$上黎曼可积，证明$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{k\leq n,k\in \mathcal{A}}f\left(\frac{k}{n}\right)=p\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx$$

nodes.source_note: 把条件函数展开为新的和或积分然后换序
nodes.english_source_note: Expand Conditions into Sums or Integrals and Swap Order

strategies.callout_id: 把条件函数展开为新的和或积分然后换序#1
strategies.english_title: Expand the Condition into a Sum
strategies.strategy_name_en: Expand an indicator condition into a sum and interchange summation order
strategies.summary_en: Rewrite a constrained sum using an indicator function, then expand that indicator as an auxiliary sum. After that, interchange the order of summation to transform the original problem into a more tractable one.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a summation is restricted by a condition on the indices and the corresponding indicator function can be represented as a sum over simpler objects.
strategies.callout_body:
当我们遇到形如$$\sum_{a,b;\text{cond}}f(a,b)
=\sum_{a,b}f(a,b)1_{\text{cond}}(a,b)$$其中cond表示一个与$a,b$有关的一个条件。我们想到可以把$1_{\text{cond}}(a,b)$函数展开成一个求和的形式
$$1_{\text{cond}}(a,b)=\sum_{c}g_c(a,b)$$这样展开以后，我们就得到一个双重求和:
$$\begin{aligned}\sum_{a,b;\text{cond}}f(a,b) &=
\sum_{a,b}f(a,b)1_{\text{cond}}(a,b) \\ &=
\sum_{a,b}f(a,b)\sum_{c}g_c(a,b) =
\sum_{a,b}\sum_{c}f(a,b)g_c(a,b) \\ &=
\sum_{c}\sum_{a,b}f(a,b)g_c(a,b)\end{aligned}$$

strategies.callout_id: 把条件函数展开为新的和或积分然后换序#2
strategies.strategy_name_en: Convolution method
strategies.summary_en: Express part of the summand as a Dirichlet convolution of simpler arithmetic functions, then interchange the order of summation. This reduces the estimation of a difficult arithmetic function to estimates for more familiar ones.
strategies.applicability: Applies in multiplicative and analytic number theory when an arithmetic function admits a useful Dirichlet convolution decomposition.
strategies.callout_body: 我们把被求和对象当中的一部分展开为更简单的函数的Dirichlet卷积的形式,然后交换求和次序，从而试图把对该数论函数的估计变成对更为熟悉且简单的数论函数的估计。

strategies.callout_id: 把条件函数展开为新的和或积分然后换序#3
strategies.english_title: Common Form 1 of the Convolution Method
strategies.strategy_name_en: Partial-sum reduction via Dirichlet convolution
strategies.summary_en: If \(f=h*g\), then the partial sum \(F(x)=\\sum_{n\\le x} f(n)\) can be rewritten as \(F(x)=\\sum_{d\\le x} g(d)H(x/d)\), where \(H(x)=\\sum_{n\\le x} h(n)\). This converts the original problem into estimating weighted partial sums of a simpler function.
strategies.applicability: Applies when one wants to estimate partial sums of an arithmetic function that factors as a Dirichlet convolution and one factor has known or manageable summatory behavior.
strategies.callout_body:
假设我们需要估计$F(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)$，其中$f(x)$是某个不好处理的算术函数。然而我们知道$$f=h*g$$其中$g$相对简单，而$h$的和$H(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}h(n)$的渐近结果是已知的。那么$$\begin{aligned}F(x)&=\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)=\sum_{n\leq x}\sum_{d|n}g(d)h(n/d)\\&=\sum_{n\leq x}\sum_{d\leq x}g(d)h(n/d)1_{d|n}=\sum_{d\leq x}\sum_{n\leq x}g(d)h(n/d)1_{d|n}\\&=\sum_{d\leq x}g(d)\sum_{q\leq x/d}h(q) \\&= \sum_{d\leq x}g(d)H(x/d)\end{aligned}$$这样问题就会变成我们熟悉的问题。

当然因为Dirichlet卷积是可以交换次序的，因此我们也可以把卷积写成$f=g*h$，假设其中$g$的和为$G(x):=\sum_{d\leq x}g(d)$，这个和已知而$h$相对简单，那么重复以上过程也可以得到$$F(x)=\sum_{d\leq x}h(d)G(x/d)$$

strategies.callout_id: 把条件函数展开为新的和或积分然后换序#4
strategies.english_title: Special Form 1 of the Convolution Method
strategies.strategy_name_en: Convolution with the constant-one function
strategies.summary_en: When \(g=f*1\), the partial sum of \(g\) can be rewritten using floor terms, leading to formulas such as \(\\sum_{n\\le x} g(n)=\\sum_{n\\le x} f(n)\\lfloor x/n\floor\). Approximating the floor function then yields a main term plus an error term.
strategies.applicability: Applies when an arithmetic function is the Dirichlet convolution of another function with the constant-one function, especially in divisor-sum type problems.
strategies.callout_body: 如果数论函数具有关系$$g=f*1$$那么根据“卷积法的常见形式1”，假设$F(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)$以及$\lfloor x\rfloor=\sum_{n\leq x}1$,一般而言这个和的渐近是已知的,于是$$\sum_{n\leq x}g(n) =\sum_{n\leq x} f(n)\left\lfloor \frac{x}{n}\right\rfloor$$当然如果对最右边的形式做进一步估计,利用粗略的处理$\left\lfloor \frac{x}{n}\right\rfloor=\frac{x}{n}+O(1)$还会得到$$\sum_{n\leq x}g(n)=x\sum_{n\leq x} \frac{f(n)}{n}+O\left(\sum_{n\leq x}|f(n)|\right)$$

strategies.callout_id: 把条件函数展开为新的和或积分然后换序#5
strategies.english_title: Idea 1.2.1: Handling the Coprimality Condition in Double Sums
strategies.strategy_name_en: Remove a coprimality condition by Möbius inversion
strategies.summary_en: Replace the indicator \(1_{(a,b)=1}\) by the Möbius expansion \(\\sum_{d\\mid (a,b)} \\mu(d)\), then interchange summation and rescale variables. This transforms a sum over coprime pairs into a weighted sum of unrestricted double sums.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a double sum is restricted by a gcd condition such as \((a,b)=1\) and Möbius inversion allows the condition to be encoded algebraically.
strategies.callout_body:
如果目标是估计和
$$S_N:=\sum_{a,b\leq N;(a,b)=1}f(a,b)=\sum_{a,b\leq N}f(a,b)1_{(a,b)=1}$$其中条件函数$1_{(a,b)=1}$是个麻烦。我们可以用下面的思路展开条件函数：

令函数$$\varepsilon(n):=\begin{cases}1&n=1\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}$$考虑到Mobius函数与1的卷积$$\varepsilon=\mu*1\iff \varepsilon(n) =\sum_{d|n}\mu(d)$$那么条件函数可以写成$$1_{(a,b)=1}=\sum_{d|(a,b)}\mu(d)$$于是目标和可以改写为$$\begin{aligned}S_N&=\sum_{a,b\leq N}f(a,b)\sum_{d|(a,b)}\mu(d)\\&=\sum_{a,b\leq N}f(a,b)\sum_{d\leq N}\mu(d)1_{d|a}1_{d|b}\\&= \sum_{d\leq N}\mu(d)\sum_{a,b\leq N}f(a,b)1_{d|a}1_{d|b}\\&=\sum_{d\leq N}\mu(d)\sum_{m,n\leq \lfloor N/d \rfloor}f(dm,dn)\end{aligned}$$令$$F_d(x):=\sum_{m,n\leq x}f(dm,dn)$$假设我们知道改函数的一个估计$$F_d(\lfloor N/d\rfloor)=\text{main}_d(N)+\text{Error}_d(N)$$的估计。如果:
* $\sum_{d\leq N}|\mu(d)|\cdot |\text{Error}_d(N)|$很小
* $\sum_{d\leq N}\mu(d)\cdot\text{main}_d(N)$容易估计

那么这种处理条件函数的思路通常可行。

nodes.callout_id: Re0微积分2:自然底数e及其快速计算#1
nodes.statement_en:
a. Prove that the sequence $$S_N:=\sum_{n=0}^{N}\frac{1}{n!}$$ has a limit.
b. Assuming $S_N\to e$, prove that $$e=3-\sum_{n\geq 0}\frac{1}{(n+1)(n+2)(n+2)!}$$
c. Use the above to give a more efficient way to approximate the limit $e$ of $S_N$ (including error analysis).
key_techniques: convergence of series via partial sums
nodes.callout_body:
a. 证明序列$$S_N:=\sum_{n=0}^{N}\frac{1}{n!}$$存在极限。
b. 假设$S_N\to e$，那么证明$$e=3-\sum_{n\geq 0}\frac{1}{(n+1)(n+2)(n+2)!}$$
c. 由上面给出近似计算$S_N$的极限$e$的更高效的方式(误差分析)。

strategies.summary_en: When the numerator of the integrand is periodic, use a change of variables so the integral runs over many periods, then split the interval into complete periods plus one incomplete remainder. Reduce the asymptotic estimate to bounding the incomplete period and analyzing the contribution of one full period.
strategies.applicability: Applies to asymptotic estimates of oscillatory or periodic integrals where periodic structure can be exploited by rescaling and interval decomposition.
strategies.callout_body: 因为被积对象的分子具有周期性，在$[0,\pi]$内的积分会走过很多个周期，于是考虑通过换元得到在$[0,(N+\frac{1}{2})\pi]$上的积分，然分拆积分。(思路可以参考[[分段估计#2. 可数分段]])最后把不完整的周期分离出去，整个渐进问题就是估计一个不完整的周期，以及在一个周期里面做渐进。

nodes.source_note: 把集合问题转换为函数问题
nodes.english_source_note: Reducing Set Problems to Function Problems
nodes.callout_id: 把集合问题转换为函数问题#2
nodes.statement_en:
For sets $A,B \subset X$, their indicator functions satisfy the identities
$1_{A\cap B}(x)=1_A(x)1_B(x)$,
$1_{A\cup B}(x)=1_A(x)+1_B(x)-1_A(x)1_B(x)$,
$1_{A^c}(x)=1-1_A(x)$,
$1_{A\setminus B}(x)=1_A(x)(1-1_B(x))$,
and
$1_{A\triangle B}(x)=1_A(x)+1_B(x)-2\cdot 1_A(x)1_B(x)$.
Also, if $A+B:=\{x+y:x\in A,y\in B\}$, then
$\operatorname{supp}(1_A*1_B)\subseteq \overline{A+B}$.
nodes.callout_body:
1. $A\cap B$的特征函数$$1_{A\cap B}(x)=1_A(x)1_B(x)$$
2. $A\cup B$的特征函数$$1_{A\cup B}(x)=1_A(x)+1_B(x)-1_A(x)1_B(x)$$
3. $A^c$的特征函数$$1_{A^c}(x)=1-1_A(x)$$
4. $A\setminus B$的特征函数$$1_{A\setminus B}(x)=1_A(x)(1-1_B(x))$$这是因为我们可以把$A\setminus B$表示为$A\cap B^c$那么用交集的特征函数就能推导出来上面的关系。
5. $A\triangle B$的特征函数$$1_{A\triangle B}(x)=1_A(x)+1_B(x)-2\cdot 1_A(x)1_B(x)$$因为其中$A\triangle B=(A\setminus B)\cup (B\setminus A)$然后我们可以用$A\setminus B$的特征函数的规律推导出此结果。
6. $A+B$定义为$$A+B:=\{x+y:x\in A,y\in B\}$$该集合与特征函数$1_A,1_B$的关系为$$\text{supp}(1_A*1_B)\subseteq \overline{A+B}$$这是函数卷积的基本性质，具体可以参考[[函数卷积的基本性质#1.4 卷积支集的性质]]。

strategies.callout_id: 把集合问题转换为函数问题#1
strategies.strategy_name_en: Convert Set Problems into Function Problems via Indicator Functions
strategies.summary_en: When a problem involves a set $A \subset X$, replace the set by its indicator function $1_A(x)$ on $X$. Analyze $1_A$ using functional or analytic tools, then translate the resulting properties back into statements about $A$.
strategies.applicability: Use this when a problem is formulated in terms of sets, membership, measure, or set operations, and functional-analytic, integral, or convolution methods are easier to apply than direct set-based arguments.
strategies.callout_body: 如果一个问题种涉及集合$A\subset X$,那么可以尝试把集合$A$的问题转换为$X$上定义的特征函数$1_A(x)$的问题，然后使用分析函数的工具得到$1_A$的性质，最后把这种性质转换回$A$的性质。通常而言，处理后者的工具会更多，我们也更好入手。

strategies.callout_id: 把集合问题转换为函数问题#3
strategies.english_title: Property 1.2: Relation Between Set Measure and Indicator Functions
strategies.strategy_name_en: Express Measure Questions Through Integrals and Sums of Indicator Functions
strategies.summary_en: Replace the measure of a set by the integral of its indicator function, and replace sums of measures of sets by integrals of sums of indicator functions. For sequences of sets, introduce counting functions such as $F(x)=\sum_n 1_{A_n}(x)$ to study overlap and limsup behavior pointwise.
strategies.applicability: Use this when studying sizes of sets, sums of measures, finite cardinalities, or limsup sets in a measure space, especially when pointwise analysis of indicator sums is more tractable than direct set manipulations.
strategies.callout_body:
此外集合的测度也可以视为特征函数的积分。例如在测度空间$(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$上的一个集合$A\in \mathcal{F}$,我们可以把研究集合$A$的测度$\mu(A)$转变为研究特征函数的积分，即$$\mu(A)=\int_{X} 1_A(x)\,d\mu(x)$$
1. 如果集合$A$是一个有限集合，此时测度空间可以考虑为一个计数测度。从而变成$$|A|=\sum_{n \in A} 1_A(n)$$此时问题变成研究序列$1_A(n)$的和的问题。
2. 如果有一列元素$A_n \in \mathcal{F}$,我们需要考虑其测度的和$\sum_{n\leq N}\mu(A_n)$那么我们可以考虑构造函数$f(x):=\sum_{n\leq N}1_{A_n}(x)$，从而$$\sum_{n\leq N}\mu(A_n)=\int_X f(x)\,d\mu(x)$$因此现在目标就是搞清楚$f(x)$及其积分。
3. 一列元素$A_n \in \mathcal{F}$然后令$F(x):=\sum_{n}1_{A_n}(x)$，那么$$\limsup_{n\to \infty}A_n \iff \{x:F(x)=+\infty\}$$那么$$\mu(\limsup_{n\to \infty}A_n)=0 \iff F(x) <+\infty \text{ a.e.}$$

Let $f\in C^2([0,1])$, and define
$$R_n:=\int_0^1 f(t)\,\mathrm{d}t-\frac1n\sum_{k=0}^{n-1} f(k/n).$$
Find
$$\lim_{n\to\infty} nR_n.$$
key_techniques: comparison between integral and left-endpoint Riemann sum
nodes.callout_body: $f\in C^2([0,1])$，令$$R_n:=\int_0^1f(t)\,\mathrm{d}t-\frac1n\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}f(k/n)$$求$$\lim_{n\to \infty}nR_n$$

nodes.statement_en: If a function $f:[x,y]\to\mathbb{R}$ is monotone, then its sum over integers can be estimated by an integral in the quantitative form $$\sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}:y\leq n\leq x} f(n)=\int_y^x f(t)\,dt+O(|f(x)|+|f(y)|).$$
nodes.callout_body: 如果函数$f:[x,y]\to\mathbb{R}$是单调函数那么求和可以被积分估计(量化版本的):$$\sum_{n\in{\mathbb{Z}}:y\leq n\leq x}f(n)=\int_{y}^{x}f(t)\,dt+O(|f(x)|+|f(y)|)$$

nodes.statement_en: Let $f(t):=|\cos(2\pi t)|$. Then $$\sum_{y\leq n\leq x}\cos(2\pi n)=O(x-y).$$ However, if one ignores the monotonicity requirement in the simple integral estimate and applies it blindly, one would incorrectly obtain an $O(1)$ estimate.
nodes.callout_body: $f(t):=|\cos(2\pi t)|$，那么和$$\sum_{y\leq n\le x}\cos(2\pi n)=O(x-y)$$可是如果无视"简单积分估计"对单调性的要求，直接根据上面的结果去强行做估计就会得出$O(1)$这样的错误的估计。

nodes.statement_en: Suppose $f:[M,+\infty)\to\mathbb{R}$ is integrable as an improper integral, is monotone decreasing to $0$, and $$\int_M^{\infty} f(t)\,dt$$ converges. Then the series $$\sum_{n\geq M} f(n)$$ also converges, and conversely.
nodes.callout_body: 如果说被求和函数$f:[M,+\infty)\to\mathbb{R}$可积(或者说广义黎曼积分存在)，并且函数单调减少到0,并且函数的积分$$\int_{M}^{\infty}f(t)\,dt $$是收敛的积分。那么级数$$\sum_{n\geq M}f(n)$$也是收敛的，反之亦然。

nodes.statement_en: The Euler-Maclaurin summation formula gives expansions such as $$\sum_{k=m}^{n}f(k)=\int_{m}^{n}f(t)dt+\frac{f(m)+f(n)}{2}+\sum_{r=1}^{\lfloor p/2\rfloor}\frac{B_{2r}}{(2r)!}\left(f^{(2r-1)}(n)-f^{(2r-1)}(m)\right)+\frac{(-1)^{p+1}}{p!}\int_{m}^{n}B_{p}(\{t\})f^{(p)}(t)dt,$$ and more generally $$\sum_{y<k\leq x}f(k)=\int_{y}^{x}f(t)dt+\sum_{k=1}^{p}\frac{(-1)^k}{k}\left(B_k(\{x\})f^{(k-1)}(x)-B_k(\{y\})f^{(k-1)}(y)\right)+\frac{(-1)^{p+1}}{p!}\int_{y}^{x}B_{p}(\{t\})f^{(p)}(t)dt.$$
nodes.callout_body:
1.  整数的情况:(这里面主要是奇数的Bernoulli数是0，所以可以消去)$$\sum_{k=m}^{n}f(k)=\int_{m}^{n}f(t)dt+\frac{f(m)+f(n)}{2}+\sum_{r=1}^{\lfloor p/2\rfloor}\frac{B_{2r}}{(2r)!}\left(f^{(2r-1)}(n)-f^{(2r-1)}(m)\right)+\frac{(-1)^{p+1}}{p!}\int_{m}^{n}B_{p}(\{t\})f^{(p)}(t)dt$$
2.  更一般的情况：$$\sum_{y<k\leq x}f(k)=\int_{y}^{x}f(t)dt+\sum_{k=1}^{p}\frac{(-1)^k}{k}\left(B_k(\{x\})f^{(k-1)}(x)-B_k(\{y\})f^{(k-1)}(y)\right)+\frac{(-1)^{p+1}}{p!}\int_{y}^{x}B_{p}(\{t\})f^{(p)}(t)dt$$
3. 最简单的情形:$$\begin{aligned}\sum_{y<k\leq x}f(k)&=\int_{y}^{x}f(t)dt-\left(B_1(\{x\})f(x)-B_1(\{y\})f(y)\right)+\int_{y}^{x}B_1(\{t\})f'(t)dt\\&=\int_{y}^{x}f(t)dt-\{x\}f(x)+\{y\}f(y)+\int_{y}^{x}\{t\}f'(t)dt\end{aligned}$$

strategies.strategy_name_en: Integral Estimation via Convexity
strategies.summary_en: Replace discrete values of a convex function by averages over unit intervals using the Hermite-Hadamard inequality. This yields lower bounds for sums that slightly improve the bounds obtained from monotonicity alone.
strategies.applicability: Use when the summand comes from a convex function, especially a monotone convex function, and you want a sharper sum-versus-integral lower bound.
strategies.callout_body:
简单的积分估计本质上是一种[[逐项估计]]，我们利用函数的单调性，然后把函数在整数处的取值放缩为函数在长度为1的区间上的积分。按照相同的思路，有时候我们也可以利用函数的凸性来把函数逐项放缩为长度为1的区间上的积分。

其主要参考的命题为：
对于在区间$[a,b]$上凸的函数而言，对任意$x_1,x_2\in [a,b]$并且满足$x_1<x_2$都有$$\frac{f(x_1)+f(x_2)}{2}\geq \frac{1}{x_2-x_1}\int_{x_1}^{x_2} f(x)\,dx$$
* 参考[[Hermite-Hadamard不等式与函数凸性]].

那么对每个区间利用这样的结果进行放缩，我们得到$$\sum_{k=1}^{n-1} \frac{f(x_k)+f(x_{k+1})}{2}(x_{k+1}-x_k)\geq \int_{x_1}^{x_n}f(x)\,dx$$如果$x_k=k$那么以上结果可以等价于$$\sum_{k=1}^n f(k)\geq \frac{f(1)+f(n)}{2}+\int_{1}^{n}f(x)\,dx$$

---
这种估计，对于单调凸函数而言是对和的下界估计的精度改进，这种改进不是本质的，误差级别不会变但是下界要比单纯利用单调性会好上一点。

比如我们假设$f$是严格单调减少的，单纯利用单调性得到的下界估计是$$\sum_{k=1}^n f(k)\geq f(n)+\int_{1}^n f(x)\,dx$$相对于利用凸性得到的下界估计，由于严格单调减少性$$\frac{f(1)+f(n)}{2}\geq f(n)$$于是我们知道由凸性得到的下界估计会好上一些，但不本质。

同样的道理，如果我们假设函数严格单调增加，那么单纯利用单调性得到的下界估计是$$\sum_{k=1}^n f(k)>f(1)+\int_{1}^n f(x)\,dx$$由于严格增加性，于是$$\frac{f(1)+f(n)}{2}\geq f(1)$$因此由凸性得到的下界估计会更好一些。

strategies.english_title: Continuous Version of Summation by Parts
strategies.strategy_name_en: Continuous Summation by Parts
strategies.summary_en: Write a weighted sum $\sum g(n)f(n)$ in terms of the partial sums $A(x)=\sum_{n\le x}g(n)$ and an integral involving $f'$. If $A(x)$ has a good estimate, the transformed expression is often easier to bound.
strategies.applicability: Use when a sum has the form $\sum g(n)f(n)$, the partial sums of $g$ are understood, and $f$ is differentiable enough to support integration by parts.
strategies.callout_body:
1.  假设我们要估计一个求和函数:$$S(x):=\sum_{y<n\leq x}g(n)f(n)$$其中$f:[y,x]\to\mathbb{C}$是一个连续可微的函数，而$g:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{C}$只要求是一个算术函数。
2.  如果我们可以对其中的算术函数的部分，给出一个求和估计，并且这个求和估计"还不错".$$A(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}g(n)$$
3.  于是我们可以尝试下面的分部求和公式，试着让原来的$S(x)$有一个更简单的形式：$$S(x)=\sum_{y<n\leq x}g(n)f(n)=A(x)f(x)-A(y)f(y)-\int_{y}^{x}A(t)f'(t)dt$$

这样做的好处是，因为$A(x)$的估计还不错，所以最后的积分的估计"理应也还可以"，从而导致最后求和的估计会比原来的表达更简单一些。

nodes.english_title: Basic Properties of This Distribution Function
nodes.statement_en: Let \((X,\mathcal{F},\mu)\) be a measure space and let \(\lambda_f(a):=\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>a\})\). Then: (1) \(\lambda_f\) is decreasing and right-continuous; (2) if \(|f|\leq |g|\), then \(\lambda_f\leq \lambda_g\); (3) if \(|f_n|\uparrow |f|\), then \(\lambda_{f_n}\uparrow \lambda_f\); (4) if \(f=g+h\), then \(\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(a/2)+\lambda_h(a/2)\); (5) if \(f=gh\), then \(\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(\sqrt{a/2})+\lambda_h(\sqrt{a/2})\).
nodes.callout_body:
1. $\lambda_f$是一个单调减少并且右连续的函数。
2. 如果$|f|\leq |g|$那么$\lambda_f \leq \lambda_g$
3. 如果$|f_n|\uparrow |f|$那么$\lambda_{f_n}\uparrow \lambda_f$
4. 如果$f = g+h$那么$\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(a/2)+\lambda_h(a/2)$
5. 如果$f = gh$那么$\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(\sqrt{a/2})+\lambda_h(\sqrt{a/2})$

nodes.source_note: 分段估计
nodes.english_source_note: Piecewise Estimates
nodes.callout_id: 分段估计#8
nodes.statement_en: Estimate \(S_N:=\sum_{N<n\leq N^2}\frac{1}{n^2+1}\) using termwise bounds and piecewise splitting. A direct bound gives \(S_N=O(1)\), while splitting at \(N^{3/2}\) yields \[\begin{aligned}S_N&=\sum_{N<n\leq N^{3/2}}\frac{1}{n^2+1}+\sum_{N^{3/2}<n\leq N^{2}}\frac{1}{n^2+1}\\&<\frac{1}{N^2}(N^{3/2}-N)+\frac{1}{N^3}(N^2-N^{3/2})\\&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}-\frac{1}{N^{3/2}}=O\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}\right).\end{aligned}\]
key_techniques: piecewise splitting of the summation range
nodes.callout_body: 假设我们现在要估计和$S_N:=\sum_{N<n\leq N^2}\frac{1}{n^2+1}$。当然和的积分估计可以告诉我们$S_N \asymp \frac{1}{N}$。但这里我们假装不知道这个做法，我就就是要用逐项估计来解决问题。于是我们想到当$N<n\leq N^2$的时候有$$\frac{1}{n^2+1}<\frac{1}{N^2}$$于是直接逐项估计我们得到$$S_N<\frac{1}{N^2}\times (N^2-N)=1-\frac{1}{N}=O(1)$$我们带着答案去审视这个估计就会发现，这个估计距离真正理想的结果差太远了，它甚至不是一个无穷小量。于是我们引入分段估计来着手改造它，我们可以引入一个$(N,N^2] \cap \mathbb{N}$的分段点，比如$N^{3/2}$好了。那么此时我们结合分段估计，再来做一次逐项估计就会得到$$\begin{aligned}S_N&:=\sum_{N<n\leq N^2}\frac{1}{n^2+1}\\&= \sum_{N<n\leq N^{3/2}}\frac{1}{n^2+1}+\sum_{N^{3/2}<n\leq N^{2}}\frac{1}{n^2+1}\\&<\frac{1}{N^2}\times (N^{3/2}-N)+\frac{1}{N^3}\times \left(N^2-N^{3/2}\right)\\&= \frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}-\frac{1}{N^{3/2}}=O\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}\right)\end{aligned}$$虽然如果对比“标准答案”这个精度还是有很大差距，但是的确比直接进行逐项估计改善了很多精度。**在很多真正的问题（并非玩具模型）当中，我们可能没有一个类似于“和的积分估计”相对于该例子这样的如此理想的工具，但是我们依旧可以通过选择合适的断点来一定程度上优化估计精度。**

strategies.strategy_name_en: Base Times Height
strategies.summary_en: Estimate an integral or sum crudely by bounding the integrand or summand uniformly and multiplying that bound by the measure or size of the underlying set. For nonnegative objects, the same idea also gives lower bounds from a uniform lower bound.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a function or sequence is uniformly bounded above or below on a finite-measure set or a finite index set, and a rough first estimate is sufficient.
strategies.callout_body:
1. **积分版本(上界)**:在测度空间$(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$上的某个有限测度的集合$E$上对上界为$M$的函数$f$求积分，那么一个非常粗略的积分估计就是$$\left|\int_{E}f\,d\mu\right|\leq \int_{E}\left|f\right|\,d\mu\leq M\mu(E)$$
2. **积分版本(下界)**:在测度空间$(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$上的某个有限测度的集合$E$上对有下界为$M$的非负函数$f$求积分，那么一个非常粗略的积分估计就是$$\int_{E}f\,d\mu \geq M\mu(E)$$
3. **求和版本**: 如果被求和函数$a_n$在整数的某个有限子集$E$上求和，并且有上界$M$，那么$$\left|\sum_{n\in E} a_n \right| \leq M |E| $$实际上求和版本不过是把积分版本的测度换成了特殊的counting measure.于是同样的如果被求和是非负的对象，那么也有类似的下界估计。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Piecewise Estimation by Divide and Conquer
strategies.summary_en: When a single global bound is too crude, split the domain into subsets on which the function exhibits different behaviors, and estimate each part separately with tailored arguments. This improves precision by replacing one rough estimate with several more adapted ones.
strategies.applicability: Applies to integrals or sums when different regions of the domain admit different kinds of control.
strategies.callout_body:
1. 我们要对一个积分$\int_{E}f\,d\mu$做估计，但是直接用"底乘高"即$\mu(E)M$太粗糙了，基本很难得到有价值的结果。
2. 我们发现$f$在集合$E$的两个子集$E_1,E_2$上有两种不同的特性出现，为了让估计误差更小，于是做$$\int_{E}\left|f\right|\,d\mu \leq \int_{E_1}\left|f\right|\,d\mu +\int_{E_2}\left|f\right|\,d\mu $$这样的分段处理。我们会对每一段用针对性的手法进行估计，也就是所谓的"**分而治之**"。

strategies.english_title: Using Piecewise Estimation in Function Convergence
strategies.strategy_name_en: Piecewise Estimation for Convergence of Functions
strategies.summary_en: To bound \(\int_E |f_n(x)|\,d\mu(x)\), split \(E\) into a region where \(|f_n|\) has a direct pointwise bound and a complementary region whose contribution can be controlled by norm estimates or small measure. This is especially useful for showing smallness as \(n\to\infty\).
strategies.applicability: Applies to parameter-dependent function sequences, especially in \(L^p\) settings or for uniformly bounded functions, when different parts of the domain are controlled in different ways.
strategies.callout_body:
如果我们想要估计$\int_E |f_n(x)|\,d\mu(x)$的上界,然后我们发现当$x\in E_n$的时候，$|f_n(x)|<M_n$(当然$M_n$也可能是一个常数),而剩下的部分又可以很好的被控制起来，那么此时可以尝试用分段估计提升估计精度。
1. 如果$f_n$是$L^p$的序列，那么$$\begin{aligned}\int_E |f_n(x)|\,d\mu(x)&\leq \int_{E_n}*+\int_{E\setminus E_n}* \\ &\leq M_n\mu(E)+\frac{||f_n||_{L^p}}{M_n^p}\end{aligned}$$
2. 如果$|f_n|<M$是有界的函数列，那么尾部也可以用有界性结合$\mu(E\setminus E_n)$来控制。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Improve the Base Instead of the Height
strategies.summary_en: When termwise estimation already gives the best available bound on each summand or integrand, improve the total estimate by shrinking or partitioning the underlying domain rather than refining the pointwise bound itself. This reframes the estimate as improving the effective size of the set being summed or integrated over.
strategies.applicability: Applies when pointwise bounds cannot be sharpened, but the domain can be decomposed so that separate pieces contribute more efficiently.
strategies.callout_body: 在一个和（或积分）的估计$\sum_I X$当中，当我们考虑[[逐项估计]]的时候，我们想象一个底乘以高的模型。此时如果我们想要改进逐项估计的精度，但是又发现我们不能改善“高”也就是$X$的估计，那么我们还可以考虑改善底，也就是做一个分段估计。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Split Off the Uniformly Controllable Part
strategies.summary_en: When the remainder terms in a sum or integral cannot be controlled uniformly over the whole domain, partition or truncate the domain so that at least one part admits a uniform estimate. The remaining part is then handled by a different argument.
strategies.applicability: Applies when global uniform control fails, but partial uniform control becomes available after splitting the domain or range.
strategies.callout_body: 当我们对一个和或者积分做逐项估计的时候我们发现其余项并不能得到统一的控制。那么这个时候一个很自然的想法就出现了：我们把变量所在的集合或者区间进行划分（或截断），从而使得至少其中一部分的余项可以被统一地控制，剩下那部分我们再想别的办法。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Isolate the Singular Region
strategies.summary_en: For parameter-dependent sums or integrals whose asymptotic behavior is driven by a singularity, split the domain into a neighborhood of the singular point and its complement. Estimate the two pieces separately, using different methods near and away from the singularity.
strategies.applicability: Applies to limits of parameter-dependent integrals or sums when there is a distinguished point where the main contribution concentrates.
strategies.callout_body: 这种一般出现在含参数的和或者积分的估计问题当中，特别是需要求含参数和或者积分的极限的问题。假设$$I_n:=\int_E f_n(x)\,dx$$然后$f_n(x)$在$E$上存在一个奇点$x_0\in E$，其余部分$f_n$有界，并且除去奇点以外$f_n(x)\to 0$。也就是说，这个含参数的积分的极限基本由$f_n$在奇点附近的行为决定。于是这个时候我们可以通过对$E$进行划分$$E=U(x_0)\cup (E\setminus U(x_0))$$于是积分估计变成估计$$I_n=\int_{E\setminus U(x_0)}+\int_{U(x_0)}$$两部分。两部分我们需要用不同的方式去估计，从而使得精度尽可能提高。

strategies.strategy_name_en: Countable Piecewise Decomposition
strategies.summary_en: Represent the domain as a countable disjoint union and rewrite the original sum or integral as a grouped sum over those pieces. The method is useful when each piece is significantly easier to estimate than the whole object at once.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a sum or integral can be naturally grouped over a countable partition and each group has better structure for estimation.
strategies.callout_body:
所谓可数分段其实就是分组求和。假设我们可以把求和或者积分的集合$X$表示为可数个不相交的子集的并，即$$X=\bigcup_{k\geq 1}A_k$$然后我们考虑基于$A_k$的分组求和/求积分：
1. 如果是测度$\mu$上的积分，我们可以理解为$$\int_X f(x)\,d\mu(x)=\sum_{k\geq 1}\int_{A_k}f(x)\,d\mu(x)$$
2. 如果是$\mathbb{N}$上的求和，那么我们可以理解为$$\sum_{n\geq 1}f(n)=\sum_{k\geq 1}\sum_{n\in A_k}f(k)$$
同时，还要求$\int_{A_k}f(x)\,d\mu(x),\sum_{n\in A_k}f(k)$比原来的对象明显更好处理，更容易做估计。那么把问题转换为后者去考虑，则称之为“基于$f$的可数分段的估计”。

nodes.callout_body: $a_n$是一个非负不增的实数列，并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$发散。证明级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{a_n,1/n\}$发散。

nodes.callout_id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#4
nodes.statement_en: Let $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ be two nonnegative nonincreasing real sequences, and suppose both series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n$ and $\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$ diverge. Must the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$ also diverge?
nodes.callout_body: $\alpha_n,\beta_n$是两个非负不增的实数列，并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n,\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$发散。那么级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$是否一定发散？

nodes.source_note: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散
nodes.english_source_note: Competing Decreasing Sequences and Series Divergence
nodes.callout_id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#6
nodes.statement_en:
A concrete construction is given by
$$F_k:=\begin{cases}2^{-2^k}&k\text{ is odd} \\ 2^{-2^{k+1}} &k\text{ is even}\end{cases},\qquad G_k:=\begin{cases}2^{-2^{k+1}}&k\text{ is odd} \\ 2^{-2^{k}} &k\text{ is even}\end{cases},\qquad L_k=2^{2^{k}}.$$ Then the block sequences $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ built from these data satisfy that both corresponding series diverge, while
$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}=\sum_{k\geq 1}L_k\min\{F_k,G_k\}=\sum_{k\geq 1} \frac{1}{2^{2^k}}<+\infty.$$
nodes.callout_body:
关于以上分析，一个解决方案是令$$F_k:=\begin{cases}2^{-2^k}&k是奇数 \\ 2^{-2^{k+1}} &k是偶数\end{cases},G_k:=\begin{cases}2^{-2^{k+1}}&k是奇数 \\ 2^{-2^{k}} &k是偶数\end{cases},L_k=2^{2^{k}}$$如此一来:
1. 当$k$是奇数的时候$L_kF_k=1$当$k$是偶数的时候$L_kF_k=\frac{1}{2^{2^k}}$于是这足以保证$\alpha_n$对应的级数的发散性。
2. 当$k$是偶数的时候$L_kG_k=\frac{1}{2^{2^k}}$，当$k$是奇数的时候$L_kG_k=1$这足以保证$\beta_n$对应的级数的发散性。

此时
$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}=\sum_{k\geq 1}L_k\min\{F_k,G_k\}=\sum_{k\geq 1} \frac{1}{2^{2^k}}<+\infty$$

nodes.english_source_note: Competing Decreasing Sequences and Series Divergence
nodes.callout_id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#7
nodes.statement_en:
Let $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ be nonnegative nonincreasing real sequences such that both series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n$ and $\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$ diverge. Assume moreover that there exists a positive real number $c$ such that for all sufficiently large $n$,
$$2^n\beta_{2^n}\geq c >0.$$ Then the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$ diverges.
nodes.callout_body: $\alpha_n,\beta_n$是一个非负不增的实数列，并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n,\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$均发散，此外存在一个正实数$c$对于足够大的$n$都有$$2^n\beta_{2^n}\geq c >0$$那么级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$发散

nodes.statement_en:
Let $a_n$ be a nonnegative nonincreasing real sequence such that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$ diverges. If $S\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ has positive natural density, that is,
$$d(S)=\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{|S\cap \{1,2,\cdots,N\}|}{N}=\delta>0,$$
then the subseries $\sum_{n\in S}a_n$ also diverges.
nodes.callout_body: 设$a_n$是一个非负，单调不增的实数列，且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$发散。如果$S\subseteq \mathbb{N}$是自然的一个子集，其自然密度为正，即$$d(S)=\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{|S\cap \{1,2,\cdots,N\}|}{N}=\delta>0$$那么子级数$\sum_{n\in S}a_n$也发散。

nodes.statement_en:
Let $f:[1,+\infty)\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy:
1. $f(x)$ is locally integrable on this interval, that is, it is Riemann integrable on every closed interval $[1,M]$.
2. $f(x)$ is nonnegative and nonincreasing on this interval.

Then the improper integral $\int_{1}^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$ converges if and only if the series $\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty}2^n f(2^n)$ converges.
nodes.callout_body:
设函数$f:[1,+\infty)\to \mathbb{R}$满足下列的条件：
1. $f(x)$在该区间上是局部可积的，即对任意闭区间$[1,M]$上都是黎曼可积的。
2. $f(x)$在该区间上非负单调不增。

那么广义积分$\int_{1}^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$收敛，当且仅当级数$\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty}2^n f(2^n)$收敛。

nodes.source_note: Silverman–Toeplitz定理
nodes.english_source_note: Silverman-Toeplitz Theorem
nodes.callout_id: Silverman–Toeplitz定理#1
nodes.statement_en:
Let $a_{n,k}$ be a nonnegative double sequence such that:
1. the sum over $k$ is $1$, namely $$\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}=1,$$
2. for each fixed $k$, $$\lim_{n\to\infty} a_{n,k}=0.$$
Then for every convergent sequence $x_n$, one has
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n.$$
key_techniques: splitting a convergent sequence into limit plus error
nodes.callout_body:
$a_{n,k}$是一个非负的双重序列，并且满足:
1. 关于$k$的和为1，即:$$\sum_{k=1}^na_{n,k}=1$$
2. 当$k$固定的时候，$$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_{n,k}=0$$

那么对于任意的有极限的序列$x_n$，都有$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n$$

nodes.source_note: Silverman–Toeplitz定理
nodes.english_source_note: Silverman-Toeplitz Theorem
nodes.callout_id: Silverman–Toeplitz定理#2
nodes.english_title: Proposition 2.1: Generalization of the Silverman-Toeplitz Theorem
nodes.statement_en:
Let $a_{n,k}$ be a double sequence such that:
1. the sum over $k$ tends asymptotically to $1$, namely $$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}=1,$$
2. for each fixed $k$, $$\lim_{n\to\infty} a_{n,k}=0,$$
3. $$\sup_{n\in\mathbb{N}^{+}}\sum_{k\le n}|a_{n,k}|<+\infty.$$
Then for every convergent sequence $x_n$, one has
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^n a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n.$$
nodes.callout_body:
$a_{n,k}$是一个双重序列，并且满足:
1. 关于$k$的和**渐进**为1，即:$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^na_{n,k}=1$$
2. 当$k$固定的时候，$$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_{n,k}=0$$
3. $$\sup_{n\in \mathbb{N}^{+}}\sum_{k\leq n}|a_{n,k}|<+\infty$$

那么对于任意的有极限的序列$x_n$，都有$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}a_{n,k}x_k=\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n$$

nodes.source_note: Silverman–Toeplitz定理
nodes.english_source_note: Silverman-Toeplitz Theorem
nodes.callout_id: Silverman–Toeplitz定理#3
nodes.statement_en:
If $|\lambda|<1$ and the sequence $x_n$ converges to $a$, then
$$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\lambda^{n-k}x_k\to \frac{a}{1-\lambda}.$$
nodes.callout_body: $|\lambda|<1$序列$x_n$的极限为$a$，那么$$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\lambda^{n-k}x_k\to \frac{a}{1-\lambda}$$这是因为$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\lambda^{n-k}=\frac{1-\lambda^{n+1}}{1-\lambda}$，所以Silverman-Toepliz定理的推广版本告诉我们$$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\lambda^{n-k}(1-\lambda)x_k\to a$$从而得到结果。

nodes.source_note: Silverman–Toeplitz定理
nodes.english_source_note: Silverman-Toeplitz Theorem
nodes.callout_id: Silverman–Toeplitz定理#4
nodes.statement_en:
Define
$$a_{n,k}:=\begin{cases}1&(n,k)=(1,1)\\n&(n,k)=(n,n)\\1-n&(n,k)=(n,n-1)\\0&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$$
This double sequence does not satisfy condition 3 of Proposition 2.1. Let $$x_k:=\frac{(-1)^k}{k}.$$ Then
$$\sum_{k\le n} a_{n,k}x_k = a_{n,n-1}x_{n-1}+a_{n,n}x_n = 2(-1)^n,$$
so the limit of the sum does not exist, and therefore it cannot equal the limit $0$ of $x_k$.
key_techniques: direct evaluation of the transformed sequence
nodes.callout_body: 令$$a_{n,k}:=\begin{cases}1&(n,k)=(1,1)\\n&(n,k)=(n,n)\\1-n&(n,k)=(n,n-1)\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}$$这个序列可以看成一个无穷的矩阵$A$当中的元素：$$A:=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&0&\cdots\\-1&2&0&\cdots\\ 0&-2&3&\cdots \\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&\ddots \\0&\cdots&1-n&n\\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&\ddots \end{pmatrix}$$这样的双重序列并不满足“命题2.1”的第三个条件，因为此时$$\sum_{k\leq n}|a_{n,k}|=2\sum_{k=1}^{n} k=n(n+1)$$令$x_k:=\frac{(-1)^k}{k}$那么$$\sum_{k\leq n} a_{n,k}x_k = a_{n,n-1}x_{n-1}+a_{n,n}x_{n}=2(-1)^n$$这个和的极限不存在，更不会等于$x_k$的极限0。

nodes.source_note: 基于分部积分法的积分的估计
nodes.english_source_note: Integral Estimates via Integration by Parts

strategies.callout_id: 基于分部积分法的积分的估计#1
strategies.strategy_name_en: Estimate Integrals by Integration by Parts
strategies.summary_en: To estimate an integral of the form $\int fg$, use integration by parts when an antiderivative $F$ of $f$ is known or easy to estimate and the derivative $g'$ is known or easy to control. This can replace the original integral by a boundary term plus a new integral $\int Fg'$, which may admit a sharper estimate.
strategies.applicability: Applies when estimating integrals whose integrand can be split into two factors so that one side becomes easier after antidifferentiation and the other after differentiation, especially when repeated integration by parts improves decay or precision.
strategies.callout_body:
参照[[基于分部求和法的和的估计]]，在积分的估计中我们也可以有类似的思考方式，即当我们要估计形如$\int fg$的积分的时候，如果我们发现：
1. $f$的部分积分$F$的估计是已知的，或者相对容易的。
2. $g$的微分$g'$是已知的，或者相对容易估计的。
那么通过分部积分$$\int fg = A+\int Fg'$$那么我们可以得到新的估计$$\left|\int fg\right|\leq |A|+\left|\int Fg'\right|$$

有的时候，为了使得积分估计的精度更高从而使用分部积分法，目的是在每次分部积分的时候从积分当中抛出一部分函数，从而使得剩下的新的积分其估计精度更高。

strategies.callout_id: 基于分部积分法的积分的估计#2
strategies.strategy_name_en: Use Vanishing Boundary Terms in Integration by Parts
strategies.summary_en: When applying $\int_a^b u\,dv = [uv]_a^b - \int_a^b v\,du$, if the boundary term $[uv]_a^b$ vanishes, then the original integral is transformed exactly into $-\int_a^b v\,du$. The transformed integral often reveals decay or is easier to estimate sharply.
strategies.applicability: Applies when one factor vanishes at the boundary, or other conditions force the boundary contribution to be zero, making the integration-by-parts identity especially effective for estimation.
strategies.callout_body:
根据一维的分部积分$$\int_{a}^b u\,dv = [uv]_a^b - \int_a^b v\,du$$如果被积函数当中$u,v$当中有一个在边界上消失，亦或是其他什么条件导致$[uv]_a^b=0$，那么我们就能得到关系$$\int_{a}^b u\,dv=-\int_a^b v\,du$$
1. 有些情况下，后者往往能提供一些关于前者如何衰减的信息。估计后者往往比估计前者，更容达到目标估计精度。

nodes.statement_en:
The following statements are equivalent:
1. $\pi(x)\sim \frac{x}{\log(x)}$
2. $\vartheta(x)\sim x$
3. $\sum_{n\leq x}\frac{\Lambda(n)}{n}=\log(x)-\gamma+o(1)$
4. $\psi(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}\Lambda(n)\sim x$
5. $\sum_{n\leq x}\mu(n)=o(x)$
6. $\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{\mu(n)}{n}=0$
key_techniques: equivalent formulations of the prime number theorem

nodes.english_title: Lemma 1.1.1: Wintner Mean Value Theorem, Early 20th Century
nodes.statement_en: If an arithmetic function $f$ is the Dirichlet convolution sum of another arithmetic function $g$, namely $$f=1*g,$$ and if the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$ converges absolutely, then the mean value $M(f)$ of $f$ equals the sum of that series, that is, $$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}.$$
prerequisites: mean value of an arithmetic function
nodes.callout_body: 如果算术函数$f$是另外一个算术函数$g$的Dirichlet卷积意义下的和，即$$f=1*g$$并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$绝对收敛，那么$f$的平均值$M(f)$就是该级数收敛到的值,即：$$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$

nodes.callout_body: 如果算术函数$f$是另外一个算术函数$g$的Dirichlet卷积意义下的和，即$$f=1*g$$令$F(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}f(n),G(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}g(n)$如果$$F(x)=Ax+o(x)$$那么$$\sum_{n\leq x}\frac{g(n)}{n}=\frac{G(x)}{x}+A+o(1)$$

nodes.callout_id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#4
nodes.statement_en:
Let $b>0$, and let $f(n)$ be a nonnegative arithmetic function. Write $$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}$$ for its associated Dirichlet series.

Assume that the series converges absolutely in the region $\mathrm{Re}(s)>b$, and that it admits analytic continuation to $\mathrm{Re}(s)\geq b$ as a meromorphic function $F(s)$. Suppose that in this region the function has exactly one simple pole, namely at $s=b$. If the residue of $F(s)$ at $s=b$ is $c$, then $$\sum_{n\leq x} f(n)\sim \frac{c}{b}x^b.$$
nodes.callout_body:
设$b>0$,$f(n)$是一个非负的算术函数，记$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}$是其对应的Dirichlet级数。

假设级数在$\text{Re}(s)> b$的范围内绝对收敛，并且可以解析延拓到$\text{Re}(s)\geq b$并定义亚纯函数$F(s)$,该函数在此范围内有且仅有$s=b$这一个简单极点。假设$F(s)$在$s=b$处的留数为$c$,那么$$\sum_{n\leq x} f(n)\sim \frac{c}{b}x^b$$

nodes.english_source_note: Dini's Test for Fourier Series and Applications
nodes.callout_id: 函数傅里叶展开的Dini判别及其应用#1
nodes.statement_en:
Let $f\in L^{1}([0,T))$ be a real-valued periodic function of period $T$. Suppose that for $x_0 \in [0,T)$ there exists a positive real number $\delta>0$ such that
$$\int_{|t|\leq \delta} \left |\frac{f(x_0-t)-f(x_0)}{t}\right | \,dm(t) < +\infty.$$ 
Then the Fourier series of $f$ converges to $f(x_0)$ at the point $x_0$.
key_techniques: local integral regularity near a point
prerequisites: pointwise convergence criteria for Fourier series
nodes.callout_body: $f\in L^{1}([0,T))$是实变量的周期为$T$的函数，并且对于$x_0 \in [0,T)$存在正实数$\delta>0$使得函数满足$$\int_{|t|\leq \delta} \left |\frac{f(x_0-t)-f(x_0)}{t}\right | \,dm(t) < +\infty$$那么此函数的傅里叶级数在此点收敛到函数本身。
